1_introduction.tex:12:We answer it by exhaustive, controlled anatomy. On a fixed backbone we cross five injection mechanisms (fixed slots, kinematic heads with both free and exact gravitational forms, deep-supervision probes, velocity-consistency losses, and label-free dynamics priors) with two injection regimes (post-hoc fine-tuning and from-scratch co-training), three physics domains, and seed-controlled baselines; we then validate the surviving conclusions on real video (Physion, Physion++) \citep{bear2021physion,tung2023physionpp}. We further propose a mechanistic explanation---the \emph{load-bearing problem}: physical slots occupy $2$ of $192$ latent dimensions and ${\sim}1\%$ of the prediction loss, the black-box channel redundantly encodes position, and auxiliary gradients conflict with prediction gradients (probe-to-prediction gradient ratios of $15$--$125\times$ collapse the encoder's effective dimensionality). The explanation makes a falsifiable prediction: reweighting the loss to make slots load-bearing should remove the damage. On uniform motion it does---restoring parity with the baseline ($0.132\pm0.017$ vs.\ $0.136\pm0.009$ both-OOD nMSE)---but never more, and on richer dynamics even the reweighted slot stays harmful.
4_physics_fails.tex:27:Table~\ref{tab:injection} reports the hardest clean-split latent nMSE for each mechanism against the pure free-rollout baseline---$30$ mechanism--domain cells in total. Three observations stand out. First, \emph{correct physics does not help}: on parabola, the strict gravitational head---the ground-truth functional form, with only the gravity constant learned---degrades error from $0.127$ to $0.173$, no better than an unconstrained MLP head ($0.178$). Second, \emph{labels do not help}: the label-free prior degrades all three domains (collision most, $0.393\!\to\!0.653$), and so does its fully grounded counterpart with perfect position labels ($0.131\!\to\!0.166$ on uniform; $0.393\!\to\!0.525$ on collision). Third, \emph{combinations do not rescue}: probe supervision alone is harmful ($0.131\!\to\!0.167$ on uniform, confirmed in pixel space, $20.41\!\to\!19.83$\,dB; $0.393\!\to\!0.647$ on collision), and adding it to the reweighted slot yields parity at best ($0.125$ vs.\ $0.132\pm0.017$ on uniform; $0.127$ on parabola) or clear damage ($0.607$ on collision), while its pixel rollout falls below even the baseline ($20.02$ vs.\ $20.41$\,dB). The form-free consistency loss, designed specifically for collision impulses, fails worst exactly there ($0.57$--$0.64$ vs.\ $0.393$), and fails on the smooth domains too ($0.151$ vs.\ $0.131$; $0.147$ vs.\ $0.127$).
4_physics_fails.tex:88:This account makes a falsifiable prediction: re-weighting the prediction loss so the slot dimensions carry weight (load-bearing reweighting, LBR; weight ${\sim}30$ on the slot) should remove the damage. On uniform motion it does (Table~\ref{tab:lbr}): the harmful fixed slot ($0.183$) returns exactly to baseline parity ($0.132\pm0.017$ vs.\ $0.136\pm0.009$ over three seeds)---and no further. The rescue is domain-limited: on parabola and collision even the reweighted slot remains harmful ($0.160$ vs.\ $0.127$; $0.596$ vs.\ $0.393$), where the slot's fixed content competes with richer dynamics. The surviving benefits are narrow and metric-dependent: with a kinematic head on the now load-bearing slot, velocity-OOD decoded position reaches $\rho{=}0.99$ and long-horizon pixel accuracy improves by $+1.25$\,dB on uniform (single-seed), only in smooth domains, and at the cost of degraded zero-shot transfer ($0.551$, the worst of all variants). Structure, even when made load-bearing, buys interpretability rather than net robustness---consistent with attributing the reported success of extrinsic architectures \citep{mao2024piwm} to their \emph{architecture} (physical state as the sole, unavoidable prediction pathway) rather than to physical equations.

1	\section{Physical Inductive Biases Fail}
2	\label{sec:fails}
3	
4	We inject physical structure into the shared $192$-dimensional latent through five mechanisms spanning the design space---from pinning \emph{what the state is} to constraining \emph{how it evolves}, with and without labels (Table~\ref{tab:mechanisms}). All variants run on top of free rollout, i.e., they must beat an already strong training protocol, which is the deployment-relevant question.
5	
6	\begin{table}[t]
7	\centering
8	\small
9	\begin{tabular}{@{}p{2.1cm}p{2.5cm}cc@{}}
10	\toprule
11	Mechanism & Constrains & Labels & Form \\
12	\midrule
13	Fixed slot & state value ($\latp{=}$pos.) & yes & --- \\
14	Probe & state readout & yes & --- \\
15	Kinematic head & evolution & yes & fixed/MLP \\
16	Consistency & evolution (velocity) & yes & form-free \\
17	Label-free prior & evolution & \textbf{no} & 2nd-order \\
18	\bottomrule
19	\end{tabular}
20	\caption{Five physical-structure injection mechanisms. ``Fixed/MLP'' includes the exact gravitational form $a{=}g$ with a single learnable parameter. The label-free prior requires the slot to evolve under smooth second-order dynamics without ground-truth grounding.}
21	\label{tab:mechanisms}
22	\end{table}
23	
24	\subsection{Post-hoc Injection: Every Mechanism Hurts}
25	\label{sec:posthoc}
26	
27	Table~\ref{tab:injection} reports the hardest clean-split latent nMSE for each mechanism against the pure free-rollout baseline---$30$ mechanism--domain cells in total. Three observations stand out. First, \emph{correct physics does not help}: on parabola, the strict gravitational head---the ground-truth functional form, with only the gravity constant learned---degrades error from $0.127$ to $0.173$, no better than an unconstrained MLP head ($0.178$). Second, \emph{labels do not help}: the label-free prior degrades all three domains (collision most, $0.393\!\to\!0.653$), and so does its fully grounded counterpart with perfect position labels ($0.131\!\to\!0.166$ on uniform; $0.393\!\to\!0.525$ on collision). Third, \emph{combinations do not rescue}: probe supervision alone is harmful ($0.131\!\to\!0.167$ on uniform, confirmed in pixel space, $20.41\!\to\!19.83$\,dB; $0.393\!\to\!0.647$ on collision), and adding it to the reweighted slot yields parity at best ($0.125$ vs.\ $0.132\pm0.017$ on uniform; $0.127$ on parabola) or clear damage ($0.607$ on collision), while its pixel rollout falls below even the baseline ($20.02$ vs.\ $20.41$\,dB). The form-free consistency loss, designed specifically for collision impulses, fails worst exactly there ($0.57$--$0.64$ vs.\ $0.393$), and fails on the smooth domains too ($0.151$ vs.\ $0.131$; $0.147$ vs.\ $0.127$).
28	
29	Across the grid, $28$ of $30$ cells fail to improve on the baseline, and the two apparent exceptions---both single-seed, both on parabola's \rmood{} split---do not survive scrutiny. Probe-only parabola reads $0.115$, exactly the bottom of the baseline's own seed range ($0.115$--$0.127$): seed noise. The slot carrying position$+$velocity reads $0.093$ on parabola while being the \emph{worst} uniform variant ($0.114\!\to\!0.207$) and clearly harmful on collision ($0.621$); we replicate this single cell across seeds before reading anything into it, and note that a mechanism whose sign flips across the two smooth domains cannot support a robustness claim in any case.
30	
31	\begin{table}[t]
32	\centering
33	\small
34	\begin{tabular}{@{}lccc@{}}
35	\toprule
36	 & uniform & parabola & collision \\
37	 & (both-OOD) & (\rmood) & (both-OOD) \\
38	\midrule
39	Free-rollout baseline & $0.131$ & $0.127$ & $0.393$ \\
40	\midrule
41	Fixed slot (weight $1$) & $0.183$ & $0.156$ & $0.651$ \\
42	Fixed slot $+$ LBR & $0.114$ & $0.160$ & $0.596$ \\
43	Probe ($\lambda{=}1$, $K{=}2$) & $0.167$ & $0.115^{\mathrm{n}}$ & $0.647$ \\
44	Kinematic (free MLP) & $0.155$ & $0.178$ & $0.560$ \\
45	Kinematic (strict $a{=}g$) & $0.206$ & $0.173$ & $0.559$ \\
46	Consistency$^{\mathrm{c}}$ (form-free) & $0.151$ & $0.147$ & $0.57$--$0.64$ \\
47	Label-free prior & $0.171$ & $0.172$ & $0.653$ \\
48	Grounded prior & $0.166$ & $0.156$ & $0.525$ \\
49	Slot$+$probe$+$LBR & $0.125$ & $0.127$ & $0.607$ \\
50	Slot pos$+$vel, $+$LBR & $0.207$ & $0.093^{\mathrm{n}}$ & $0.621$ \\
51	\bottomrule
52	\end{tabular}
53	\caption{Post-hoc physical-structure injection, hardest clean-split latent nMSE ($\downarrow$): both-OOD for uniform/collision; \rmood{} for parabola, whose both-OOD aggregate is invalidated by the denominator pathology of \S\ref{sec:traps}. $28$ of $30$ cells fail to improve on the baseline; the two exceptions are discussed in the text. LBR = load-bearing reweighting (\S\ref{sec:lbr}). $^{\mathrm{c}}$Consistency operates on the reweighted slot by construction. $^{\mathrm{n}}$Single-seed values at or below the baseline's seed range on this split only; see text. Cells are single-seed; the baseline and the LBR slot are seed-replicated in Tables~\ref{tab:headline} and~\ref{tab:lbr}.}
54	\label{tab:injection}
55	\end{table}
56	
57	\subsection{From-Scratch Co-Training Hurts More}
58	\label{sec:scratch}
59	
60	A natural defense holds that physical structure cannot be grafted onto an encoder already committed to a black-box representation---it must be baked in during pretraining, as extrinsic architectures do. We test this with a $2{\times}2$ factorial (init $\in$ \{PushT post-hoc, from-scratch\} $\times$ physics $\in$ \{off, on\}) per domain, with learning rate re-tuned so the from-scratch baselines converge cleanly. The defense fails, and in the strongest possible way (Table~\ref{tab:scratch}): from-scratch physics is \emph{more} damaging than post-hoc grafting. On uniform motion, the physics penalty grows from $+0.035$ (post-hoc) to $+0.558$ (from-scratch)---the cleaner the baseline, the larger the harm. All three domains show positive penalties in both regimes; the ``inject at pretraining'' escape hatch is closed.
61	
62	\begin{table}[t]
63	\centering
64	\small
65	\begin{tabular}{@{}llccc@{}}
66	\toprule
67	Domain & Split & phys.\ off & phys.\ on & $\Delta$ \\
68	\midrule
69	\multirow{2}{*}{uniform} & scratch & $0.192$ & $0.750$ & $\mathbf{+0.558}$ \\
70	 & post-hoc & $0.131$ & $0.166$ & $+0.035$ \\
71	\midrule
72	\multirow{2}{*}{parabola (\rmood)} & scratch & $0.343$ & $0.375$ & $+0.03$ \\
73	 & post-hoc & $0.124$ & $0.198$ & $+0.07$ \\
74	\midrule
75	\multirow{2}{*}{collision} & scratch & $0.538$ & $0.635$ & $+0.097$ \\
76	 & post-hoc & $0.393$ & $0.525$ & $+0.132$ \\
77	\bottomrule
78	\end{tabular}
79	\caption{Pretraining vs.\ post-hoc physics injection (latent nMSE $\downarrow$, hardest clean split; strict $a{=}g$ head $+$ fixed slot). Physics hurts in every cell, and most where the baseline is cleanest. Parabola is judged on \rmood{} due to the denominator pathology of its both-OOD aggregate (\S\ref{sec:traps}).}
80	\label{tab:scratch}
81	\end{table}
82	
83	\subsection{The Load-Bearing Problem}
84	\label{sec:lbr}
85	
86	Why does structure fail so uniformly? The physical slot occupies $2$ of $192$ dimensions; under a mean prediction loss it receives ${\sim}1\%$ of the gradient, so the predictor pays almost nothing for getting it wrong. Meanwhile the black-box channel \emph{redundantly encodes position}: even in baseline models with no slot at all, a ridge probe reads position from the latent at $\rho{>}0.9$, so a dedicated slot adds nothing the predictor does not already have, and prediction and decoding can route around it entirely. The slot aligns almost perfectly with true position (its supervision loss falls from $2.53$ to $0.015$) while contributing nothing: it is decodable but not load-bearing. Worse, the auxiliary gradients actively compete with prediction: at probe weight $\lambda{=}10$ the probe-to-prediction gradient ratio reaches $15$--$125\times$ across domains and the encoder's effective dimensionality collapses by $39$--$90\%$.
87

lines: We answer it by exhaustive, controlled anatomy. On a fixed backbone we cross five injection mechanisms (fixed slots, kinematic heads with both free and exact gravitational forms, deep-supervision probes, velocity-consistency losses, and label-free dynamics priors) with two injection regimes (post-hoc fine-tuning and from-scratch co-training), three physics domains, and seed-controlled baselines; we then validate the surviving conclusions on real video (Physion, Physion++) \citep{bear2021physion,tung2023physionpp}. We further propose a mechanistic explanation---the \emph{load-bearing problem}: physical slots occupy $2$ of $192$ latent dimensions and ${\sim}1\%$ of the prediction loss, the black-box channel redundantly encodes position, and auxiliary gradients conflict with prediction gradients (probe-to-prediction gradient ratios of $15$--$125\times$ collapse the encoder's effective dimensionality). The explanation makes a falsifiable prediction: reweighting the loss to make slots load-bearing should remove the damage. On uniform motion it does---restoring parity with the baseline ($0.132\pm0.017$ vs.\ $0.136\pm0.009$ both-OOD nMSE)---but never more, and on richer dynamics even the reweighted slot stays harmful.

-Our results separate cleanly. Physical structure fails everywhere: every injection mechanism degrades OOD prediction in every domain, and the damage \emph{grows} as baselines strengthen---with a clean from-scratch baseline, adding physics costs $+0.56$ nMSE on uniform motion, an order of magnitude more than the $+0.035$ cost of post-hoc grafting, closing the ``structure must be baked in during pretraining'' escape hatch. Training protocol succeeds everywhere: replacing teacher forcing with free rollout cuts OOD error $2.2$--$3.6\times$ across all three domains (seed-robust, non-overlapping intervals); matching the rollout horizon to dynamics complexity yields further gains, up to $19\times$ on real long-horizon video; and domain-matched augmentation halves OOD error on synthetic data---yet the same augmentation \emph{reverses} on real video, degrading friction-collision prediction $100\times$.

+Our results separate cleanly. Physical structure fails wherever it can be trusted: across $30$ mechanism--domain cells, none delivers a seed-robust improvement and most degrade prediction outright, and the damage \emph{grows} as baselines strengthen---with a clean from-scratch baseline, adding physics costs $+0.56$ nMSE on uniform motion, an order of magnitude more than the $+0.035$ cost of post-hoc grafting, closing the ``structure must be baked in during pretraining'' escape hatch. 为啥两个都写 injec-tion mechanisms，表述有些问题，two injection regimes (post-hoc and from-scratch)这个是不是写出训练方法或者其他表述好点，

and two real-world video benchmarks— physion的那两个数据集不算真实数据集吧

这是Claude的意见"real-world video" 是事实性错误，全文多处。 Physion 和 Physion++ 是 ThreeDWorld 渲染的照片级仿真视频，不是真实拍摄视频。你的 abstract、intro、contribution、实验节反复写 "two real-world video benchmarks" "real video" "real dynamic scenes"——任何用过 Physion 的审稿人都会当场抓住，而且这直接动摇你 "synthetic-to-real boundary" 这个贡献的措辞。改法：统一换成"realistic simulation benchmarks"，边界改叫 "simple-synthetic → realistic-simulated"。注意连带修改增广反转那段的解释："appearance is signal in real ones" 要改成 "in photorealistic scenes, appearance carries physical information (friction, mass, material)"——论证依然成立，但不能叫 real。

摘要大多提的是负面的实验，AAAI 评审偏好新方法;需要用"发现支配变量"的正面框架而非"负结果"框架来写，能不能提下真正有效的是训练与数据侧:free-rollout(唯一跨合成/真实通用)、rollout horizon 匹配动力学复杂度、域匹配增广(附反转警示)。如果域匹配增广还是有反转警告那就适当润色下，或者在正面方法里简单提下甚至不提。
这个是cc给的意见：
Abstract 内部有一处会被当矛盾抓的表述。 "rollout horizons matched to dynamics complexity (up to 19× on real video)" 紧接着 "augmentation—whose gains reverse catastrophically (up to 100×)"。问题是：19× 那个数（h64 0.280→0.014）来自 H=28+scale，包含了 scale 增广——而下一句说增广在真实数据上灾难性反转。不区分 appearance 和 scale，这两句在 abstract 里互相打架。同样问题在正文 horizon 节更严重："error falls monotonically through H ∈ {8,16,20,28}" 这条单调链混用了带 scale 和不带 scale 的配置（appendix 里 H=20 不带 scale 的 h64 是 0.220，带 scale 才 0.087）——审稿人对着 appendix 交叉核对就会发现单调性叙述不诚实。改法：19× 归因写成 "horizon extension combined with geometric scale jitter"；反转明确限定 "appearance augmentation reverses"；horizon 节把 scale 的 amplitude-stabilizer 角色提前说明。


全文的节引用都是空的 "(§)"。 Abstract 后半、intro、四个 contribution bullet、Experimental Setup 里至少十几处 "(§)" 没填节号。这是 LaTeX 占位符没替换，投出去等于告诉审稿人"这是没检查过的稿子"。AAAI 禁 hyperref，所以要手动或用 \ref 填。

input.content: Latent world models can \emph{decode} physical state from their representations, yet fail to \emph{obey} physical law when predictions are rolled out: a joint-embedding predictive (JEPA-style) model that recovers object position almost perfectly at one step collapses over long horizons and under out-of-distribution (OOD) physics. A popular remedy injects physical inductive biases into the latent space. Testing this remedy on a JEPA world model across five injection mechanisms (fixed physical slots, kinematic dynamics, deep-supervision probes, consistency losses, and label-free priors), two training regimes (post-hoc fine-tuning and from-scratch pretraining), three controlled physics domains, and two photorealistic-simulation benchmarks, we find it consistently \emph{hurts}, with damage growing as the baseline strengthens (up to $+0.56$ normalized MSE from scratch). We trace the failure to a \emph{load-bearing problem}: physical dimensions occupy a vanishing fraction of the latent and its gradients, so prediction routes around them; a one-line loss reweighting removes the harm where the slot matches the dynamics, but never yields a net gain. The variables that actually govern physical robustness lie in training and data, not structure: autoregressive free rollout is the single dominant lever ($2.2$--$3.6\times$ OOD error reduction across all domains, seed-robust, and the best transfer to photorealistic scenes), rollout horizons must match dynamics complexity (a $19\times$ long-horizon gain on photorealistic video when paired with geometric scale jitter), and augmentation must match the domain's true nuisances---appearance jitter, the strongest lever on simple synthetic data, \emph{reverses} catastrophically (up to $100\times$) on photorealistic scenes where appearance carries physical information. Finally, we show that cosine- and probe-based metrics are duals of the auxiliary training losses and systematically overstate physical competence, explaining why structural remedies can appear to work.

lines: We study this question in a controlled setting. A latent world model consists of an encoder mapping frames to embeddings and a predictor rolling embeddings forward, trained by matching predicted to encoded futures (JEPA). \emph{Teacher forcing} trains the predictor on one-step transitions from ground-truth context; \emph{free rollout} trains it on its own multi-step predictions \citep{bengio2015scheduled,venkatraman2015improving}. PhyWorld provides three single-mechanism physics domains---uniform motion, parabolic flight, and elastic collision---with explicit in-distribution ranges over radius/mass and velocity, yielding four evaluation partitions (ID, r/m-OOD, v-OOD, both-OOD). We report normalized MSE (nMSE) in latent space and PSNR of decoded rollouts in pixel space, and we deliberately avoid cosine similarity and probe correlation as primary metrics, for reasons the paper establishes (\S\ref{sec:traps}).

-Existing evidence for physical structure rests on fragile ground. Reported gains are typically measured by probe correlation or latent cosine---quantities we show to be \emph{duals of the auxiliary training loss itself}, which rise mechanically as that loss is optimized regardless of whether prediction improves. Injection mechanisms are evaluated in isolation, on single domains, under a single initialization regime, and rarely against the confound that dominates everything else: the training protocol. No study answers the basic factorial question---does physical structure help once training is done right?

Injection mechanisms are evaluated in isolation, on single domains, under a single initialization regime, and rarely against the confound that dominates everything else: the training protocol. No study answers the basic factorial question---does physical structure help once training is done right?

We answer it by exhaustive, controlled anatomy. On a fixed backbone we cross five injection mechanisms (fixed slots, kinematic heads with both free and exact gravitational forms, deep-supervision probes, velocity-consistency losses, and label-free dynamics priors) with two injection regimes (post-hoc fine-tuning and from-scratch co-training), three physics domains, and seed-controlled baselines; we then validate the surviving conclusions on real video (Physion, Physion++) \citep{bear2021physion,tung2023physionpp}. We further propose a mechanistic explanation---the \emph{load-bearing problem}: physical slots occupy $2$ of $192$ latent dimensions and ${\sim}1\%$ of the prediction loss, the black-box channel redundantly encodes position, and auxiliary gradients conflict with prediction gradients (probe-to-prediction gradient ratios of $15$--$125\times$ collapse the encoder's effective dimensionality). The explanation makes a falsifiable prediction: reweighting the loss to make slots load-bearing should remove the damage. On uniform motion it does---restoring parity with the baseline ($0.132\pm0.017$ vs.\ $0.136\pm0.009$ both-OOD nMSE)---but never more, and on richer dynamics even the reweighted slot stays harmful.

lines: \label{sec:setup}
\paragraph{Model.}

-We use LeWM \citep{maes2025lewm}, a compact JEPA-style action-conditioned world model (${\sim}10$M parameters): a ViT-tiny encoder $\enc$ producing a $192$-dimensional embedding, an MLP projector, a lightweight action encoder, and a $6$-layer causal-transformer predictor $\pred$. Training minimizes the latent prediction error $\|\pred(\lat_{1:t}) - \enc(o_{t+1})\|^2$ plus a SIGReg anti-collapse regularizer \citep{balestriero2025lejepa}. Unless stated otherwise, the encoder is initialized from the public PushT-pretrained checkpoint; \S\ref{sec:fails} additionally studies from-scratch training. This small, fully controlled backbone lets us run the full factorial anatomy ($>$60 training runs) with seed replication; we discuss external validity in \S\ref{sec:conclusion}.

Training minimizes the latent prediction error $\|\pred(\lat_{1:t}) - \enc(o_{t+1})\|^2$ plus a SIGReg anti-collapse regularizer \citep{balestriero2025lejepa}. Unless stated otherwise, the encoder is initialized from the public PushT-pretrained checkpoint; \S\ref{sec:fails} additionally studies from-scratch training. This small, fully controlled backbone lets us run the full factorial anatomy (over $60$ training runs) and repeat each headline configuration across three random seeds, so that reported effects can be separated from seed-to-seed noise; we discuss external validity in \S\ref{sec:conclusion}.
\paragraph{Training regimes.}

-\emph{Teacher forcing} (LeWM's default) trains one-step transitions from ground-truth context ($\mathrm{num\_preds}{=}1$). \emph{Free rollout} feeds the predictor its own predictions autoregressively for $H$ steps ($\mathrm{num\_preds}{=}H$, default $8$) and supervises the whole rollout, exposing the model to its own compounding errors during training.

+The predictor can be trained two ways. \emph{Teacher forcing} (LeWM's default) trains one-step transitions from ground-truth context ($\mathrm{num\_preds}{=}1$). \emph{Free rollout} feeds the predictor its own predictions autoregressively for $H$ steps ($\mathrm{num\_preds}{=}H$, default $8$) and supervises the whole rollout, exposing the model to its own compounding errors during training. Because free rollout is the dominant lever we identify (\S\ref{sec:fr}), it is our default throughout; all physical-structure variants are added on top of it, and teacher forcing appears only as the explicit baseline it improves upon.
\paragraph{Domains and OOD protocol.}

-PhyWorld \citep{kang2024how} provides three single-mechanism domains: \emph{uniform motion} (zero acceleration), \emph{parabola} (constant gravity), and \emph{collision} (elastic impulse; discontinuous acceleration). Models are trained on $1{,}000$ in-distribution trajectories per domain ($32$ frames, $224{\times}224$; ID means radius/mass $\in[0.7,1.5]$ and velocity $\in[1,4]$) and evaluated on four partitions: ID, \rmood{} (radius/mass out of range; changes appearance), \vood{} (velocity out of range), and \bothood{} (both out of range, the hardest split).

+PhyWorld \citep{kang2024how} provides three single-mechanism domains: \emph{uniform motion} (zero acceleration), \emph{parabola} (constant gravity), and \emph{collision} (elastic impulse; discontinuous acceleration). Each model trains on the $1{,}000$ in-distribution trajectories that define one mechanism ($32$ frames, $224{\times}224$; ID means radius/mass $\in[0.7,1.5]$ and velocity $\in[1,4]$) and is evaluated on four partitions: ID, \rmood{} (radius/mass out of range; changes appearance), \vood{} (velocity out of range), and \bothood{} (both out of range, the hardest split). The small, clean training set is deliberate: it follows PhyWorld's controlled protocol and isolates the inductive-bias question from data-scale confounds, so that any effect we measure is attributable to the injected structure rather than to data volume. We separately confirm the surviving conclusions at realistic scale below.
-\paragraph{Real-video benchmarks.}

-Physion \citep{bear2021physion} object-contact prediction (OCP) evaluates zero-shot transfer: frozen encoder, pooled features, linear readout over eight scenarios. Physion++ \citep{tung2023physionpp} supplies real dynamic scenes with ground-truth object states; we train directly on its readout clips and evaluate latent rollout up to horizon $64$.
+\paragraph{Photorealistic-simulation benchmarks.}

+Physion \citep{bear2021physion} and Physion++ \citep{tung2023physionpp} are rendered in ThreeDWorld, a Unity-based engine that produces photorealistic---not camera-captured---video with rich multi-object dynamics far beyond PhyWorld's single-mechanism scenes; they are our realism stress test. We use them in the two standard ways. On Physion we evaluate \emph{zero-shot transfer}: a PhyWorld-trained encoder is frozen and a linear object-contact-prediction (OCP) readout is fit over eight scenarios, testing whether synthetic-domain training yields features that carry to photorealistic scenes without further training. On Physion++ we instead \emph{train directly} on its readout clips (which supply ground-truth object states) and evaluate latent rollout up to horizon $64$, testing long-horizon prediction within the realistic-simulation regime itself.
\paragraph{Metrics and protocol rules.}

Our primary metrics are scale-aware: \emph{latent nMSE}, $\|\hat{\lat}-\lat\|^2$ normalized by the variance of the target latents ($0$ is perfect; ${\approx}1$ matches predicting the mean), and \emph{pixel PSNR} of rollouts decoded by a universal decoder trained per model (position dominates the visual error, making this the sharpest lens for physical accuracy; collision is excluded from pixel evaluation because its decoder is reconstruction-limited). As diagnostics only, we report latent cosine and probe decodability $\rho$ (ridge readout of position/velocity from rolled-out latents; velocity uses $K{=}4$ stacked frames). All numbers are reported per partition \emph{and} per horizon; \S\ref{sec:traps} shows why aggregate or direction-only metrics mislead, and why the parabola both-OOD aggregate specifically must be replaced by its clean \rmood{} partition. Data splits are trajectory-level. Headline comparisons use three seeds (mean$\pm$std); remaining cells are single-seed and marked accordingly.

lines: \subsection{Free Rollout Dominates}
\label{sec:fr}

-Replacing teacher forcing with free rollout is the single largest and most portable improvement we find (Table~\ref{tab:headline}): $2.2\times$ on uniform, $3.6\times$ on parabola, and $2.4\times$ on collision, with three-seed intervals that do not overlap in any domain. The diagnosis matches the classic exposure-bias account \citep{bengio2015scheduled,venkatraman2015improving}: under teacher forcing, one-step predictions are near-perfect (cosine $0.98$--$0.99$) while multi-step rollouts drift at a rate ordered by dynamics complexity (uniform $<$ parabola $<$ collision)---the failure is invisible at training time and catastrophic at rollout time. The result carries to real video: on Physion++, free rollout is the main long-horizon lever (horizon-$32$ cosine $0.91$ vs.\ $0.79$--$0.87$ for every physics-augmented variant), and among all synthetic-training configurations it transfers best to Physion OCP.

Per-trial appearance jitter (brightness/contrast, strength $0.5$) targets the appearance shift induced by radius/mass changes and roughly halves the hardest split: uniform $0.131\!\to\!0.068$ ($-48\%$), parabola $-63\%$ (with the clean \rmood{} partition confirming, $0.127\!\to\!0.065$). Velocity-OOD resists all of it---temporal-stride augmentation, the natural candidate, loses even to appearance jitter ($0.556$ vs.\ $0.376$)---marking unseen velocities as the open hard case.

input.old_string: We asked whether physical inductive biases make latent world models obey physics, and answered with a controlled anatomy: across five injection mechanisms, two injection regimes, three synthetic domains, and two real-video benchmarks, physical structure consistently harms OOD and long-horizon prediction---even the exact gravitational form, even with perfect labels, and \emph{more} when co-trained from scratch. The failure has a mechanism, the load-bearing problem: information that is present in a shared latent is not thereby used by prediction, and structure grafted onto dimensions that carry no gradient weight decorates rather than constrains. The mechanism's falsifiable prediction held---reweighting removes the harm---but restores only parity. What moves physical robustness is the training protocol: free rollout ($2.2$--$3.6\times$, seed-robust, synthetic and real), horizons matched to dynamics complexity (up to $19\times$ on real video), and augmentation matched to the domain's true nuisances, with an explicit synthetic-to-real reversal boundary. Alongside, we distilled four evaluation traps that had made structure look helpful and augmentation look safe.

\label{sec:conclusion}

-We asked whether physical inductive biases make latent world models obey physics, and answered with a controlled anatomy: across five injection mechanisms, two injection regimes, three synthetic domains, and two real-video benchmarks, physical structure consistently harms OOD and long-horizon prediction---even the exact gravitational form, even with perfect labels, and \emph{more} when co-trained from scratch. The mechanism's falsifiable prediction held---reweighting removes the harm---but restores only parity. Alongside, we distilled four evaluation traps that had made structure look helpful and augmentation look safe.

+We asked whether physical inductive biases make latent world models obey physics, and answered with a controlled anatomy: across five injection mechanisms, two training regimes, three synthetic domains, and two photorealistic-simulation benchmarks, physical structure consistently harms OOD and long-horizon prediction---even the exact gravitational form, even with perfect labels, and \emph{more} when co-trained from scratch. The failure has a mechanism, the load-bearing problem: information that is present in a shared latent is not thereby used by prediction, and structure grafted onto dimensions that carry no gradient weight decorates rather than constrains. The mechanism's falsifiable prediction held---reweighting removes the harm---but restores only parity. Alongside, we distilled four evaluation traps that had made structure look helpful and augmentation look safe.

The constructive reading is architectural. Our results do not falsify physically structured world models in general; they falsify \emph{grafting} structure onto a shared latent. Extrinsic designs---where a low-dimensional physical state is the sole pathway that prediction and decoding must route through \citep{mao2024piwm}---make physics load-bearing by construction, and our analysis predicts that this, not the physical equations themselves, is the source of their reported benefits. Testing that prediction by converting a shared-latent JEPA model to an extrinsic factorization is the direct next step; conservation-projection constraints that operate without labels are a complementary route for domains where states are unobservable.

The gains these methods report are typically read from probe correlation or latent cosine---quantities we show to be \emph{duals of the auxiliary training loss itself}, which rise mechanically as that loss is optimized regardless of whether prediction improves. Hamiltonian neural networks impose conservation structure directly on the dynamics \citep{greydanus2019hamiltonian}. These works report improved interpretability and reduced drift, typically measured by probe accuracy or latent similarity. We test the transferable core of these proposals---fixed slots, kinematic equations (including the exact gravitational form), probe supervision, and their label-free variants---inside a shared-latent JEPA model, and find all of them harmful under scale-aware metrics. Our analysis attributes the discrepancy to architecture: extrinsic designs make the physical state load-bearing by construction, whereas grafting the same ingredients onto a shared latent leaves them decorative (\S\ref{sec:lbr}).
\paragraph{Rollout training and exposure bias.}

-Training autoregressive predictors on their own outputs is a classic remedy for compounding error: scheduled sampling \citep{bengio2015scheduled}, Data-as-Demonstrator \citep{venkatraman2015improving}, and professor forcing \citep{lamb2016professor} all attack the train--test mismatch of teacher forcing, and modern latent world models train on imagined rollouts \citep{ha2018world,hafner2023dreamer}. We claim no novelty for free rollout itself. Our contribution is comparative: under identical, seed-controlled conditions, this training-protocol choice dominates \emph{every} physical-structure intervention across synthetic and real data, and we quantify a horizon--complexity matching law that assigns each domain its optimal rollout length.

\paragraph{Data augmentation for dynamics OOD.}

Physics-informed augmentation has been proposed for vehicle dynamics \citep{jin2024piaug} and world-model robustness \citep{ball2021augmented}. On synthetic domains we confirm augmentation as the strongest OOD lever---appearance jitter halves the hardest-split error---but we document two boundaries this literature has not: augmentation interactions are non-monotone (appearance conflicts with long-horizon training while geometric scaling synergizes with it), and gains reverse catastrophically on real video, where appearance is informative rather than nuisance. lines: The rollout horizon $H$ is not a free win; it must match the domain. Collision improves markedly at $H{\approx}20$ (both-OOD $0.393\!\to\!0.294$; horizon-$28$ cosine $0.58\!\to\!0.70$)---the training window must contain post-impulse futures for the model to learn them. Smooth domains show the opposite: at $H{=}16$, uniform's long-horizon cosine drops from $0.969$ to $0.814$ and parabola degrades on every partition; excess horizon destabilizes amplitudes where $H{=}8$ already spans the dynamics. On photorealistic video the appetite is larger still, but horizon alone is not the whole story. Longer horizons monotonically improve mid-range accuracy (Physion++ horizon-$32$ nMSE $0.140$ at $H{=}8$ down to $0.033$ at $H{=}20$); at long range, however, a plain long rollout can overshoot amplitude on some scenes (friction-collision nMSE $24.6$ at cosine $0.99$ under $H{=}20$ without augmentation). Pairing the long horizon with geometric scale jitter, which stabilizes amplitude, is what unlocks the regime: horizon-$64$ nMSE falls from $0.280$ ($H{=}8$) to $0.087$ ($H{=}20{+}$scale) and $0.014$ ($H{=}28{+}$scale), a $19\times$ reduction with no inflection yet found. The practical law: extend the training horizon to cover the domain's causal event span, and add geometric augmentation to keep long rollouts stable.
-\subsection{Augmentation: Strongest Synthetic Lever, Reversed on Real Video}
+\subsection{Augmentation: Strongest Synthetic Lever, Reversed on Photorealistic Video}
\label{sec:aug}

On synthetic domains, simple video-only augmentation beats every physical-structure method. Per-trial appearance jitter (brightness/contrast, strength $0.5$) targets the appearance shift induced by radius/mass changes and roughly halves the hardest split: uniform $0.131\!\to\!0.068$ ($-48\%$), parabola $-63\%$ (with the clean \rmood{} partition confirming, $0.127\!\to\!0.065$). Geometric scale jitter targets object size directly and, \emph{only} in combination with a long horizon, sets the collision record ($0.393\!\to\!0.172\pm0.004$ over three seeds). The combinations are non-monotone and must be chosen, not stacked: appearance conflicts with long-horizon training ($0.472$, worse than either alone), scale synergizes with it ($0.208$), and the triple combination is worse than the best pair ($0.253$). Velocity-OOD resists all of it---temporal-stride augmentation, the natural candidate, loses even to appearance jitter ($0.556$ vs.\ $0.376$)---marking unseen velocities as the open hard case.

## 逐条回应

**事实性硬伤 — "real" 全清**

**"(§)" 空引用 — 根因修复**
不是占位符没填,是 aaai 模板默认 `secnumdepth=0`(section 不编号)让 `\ref{sec:}` 取空。main.tex 加一行 `\setcounter{secnumdepth}{2}`,现在全解析成 §4/§6。

**Abstract 三处**
1. "two injection regimes" → **"two training regimes (post-hoc fine-tuning and from-scratch pretraining)"**,消除和 "injection mechanisms" 的重复;
2. 更正面:加了 **"The variables that actually govern physical robustness lie in training and data, not structure"**,把 free-rollout 作为 dominant lever 提前;
3. **19× vs 100× 矛盾**(CC 抓的):19× 明确归因 **"when paired with geometric scale jitter"**,反转限定 **"appearance jitter … reverses"**——scale 和 appearance 彻底分开。

**Intro**:"Reported gains" → **"The gains these methods report"**(明确指向他人工作);real/19× 同步改。

**Horizon 节的诚实性问题**(CC 抓的最狠一条):原来 "error falls monotonically through H∈{8,16,20,28}" 混用了带/不带 scale 的配置。改成:horizon-only 只管中程(H8→H20:0.140→0.033),长程要靠 **horizon+scale**(0.280→0.087→0.014),并把 scale 的 amplitude-stabilizer 角色提前说明——现在和 appendix 对得上,审稿人交叉核对不会穿。

**Setup 五处**:"seed replication" 改成白话("三个随机种子重复,把效应和种子噪声分开");明确 **free-rollout 是默认**、teacher-forcing 只作对照;1K 数据加了辩护(PhyWorld 受控协议 + 隔离 data-scale 混淆,不是数据不够);讲清 **Physion 是 zero-shot 迁移(不训)、Physion++ 是直训**——回答了你"为啥说 0 样本"的困惑。

**Table 1**:Constrains 列改成 **"what state is / how state evolves"**(呼应正文,不再有裸 "value");Form 列写成 **"$a=0,g$ / MLP"** 并在 caption 讲清只对 evolution 机制有意义。

input.old_string: Across the grid, $28$ of $30$ cells fail to improve on the baseline, and the two apparent exceptions---both single-seed, both on parabola's \rmood{} split---do not survive scrutiny. Probe-only parabola reads $0.115$, exactly the bottom of the baseline's own seed range ($0.115$--$0.127$): seed noise. The slot carrying position$+$velocity reads $0.093$ on parabola while being the \emph{worst} uniform variant ($0.114\!\to\!0.207$) and clearly harmful on collision ($0.621$); we replicate this single cell across seeds before reading anything into it, and note that a mechanism whose sign flips across the two smooth domains cannot support a robustness claim in any case.
input.new_string: Across the grid, $29$ of $30$ cells fail to improve on the baseline. One apparent exception is pure seed noise: probe-only parabola reads $0.115$, exactly the bottom of the baseline's own seed range ($0.115$--$0.127$). The other is real---and it is the exception that proves the rule. Extending the load-bearing slot to carry velocity as well as position genuinely helps on parabola (\rmood{} $0.122{\pm}0.007\!\to\!0.096{\pm}0.007$ over three seeds, non-overlapping intervals, every seed lower), yet the very same mechanism is the \emph{worst} variant on uniform ($0.114\!\to\!0.207$) and clearly harmful on collision ($0.621$). The sign flips with the role velocity plays in each domain's dynamics: on parabola velocity linearly drives the trajectory (gravity), so encoding it in the load-bearing slot \emph{matches} the dynamics and helps; on uniform velocity is constant, so the extra constrained dimension is pure overhead; on collision velocity is discontinuous, so a smooth slot cannot represent it. Structure helps if and only if it is both load-bearing \emph{and} matched to the domain's dynamics---a coincidence no fixed prior can guarantee across domains, and worth only $-0.026$ nMSE where it occurs, against the $2.2$--$3.6\times$ of free rollout (\S\ref{sec:fr}).

lines: Table~\ref{tab:injection} reports the hardest clean-split latent nMSE for each mechanism against the pure free-rollout baseline---$30$ mechanism--domain cells in total. Three observations stand out. First, \emph{correct physics does not help}: on parabola, the strict gravitational head---the ground-truth functional form, with only the gravity constant learned---degrades error from $0.127$ to $0.173$, no better than an unconstrained MLP head ($0.178$). Second, \emph{labels do not help}: the label-free prior degrades all three domains (collision most, $0.393\!\to\!0.653$), and so does its fully grounded counterpart with perfect position labels ($0.131\!\to\!0.166$ on uniform; $0.393\!\to\!0.525$ on collision). Third, \emph{combinations do not rescue}: probe supervision alone is harmful ($0.131\!\to\!0.167$ on uniform, confirmed in pixel space, $20.41\!\to\!19.83$\,dB; $0.393\!\to\!0.647$ on collision), and adding it to the reweighted slot yields parity at best ($0.125$ vs.\ $0.132\pm0.017$ on uniform; $0.127$ on parabola) or clear damage ($0.607$ on collision), while its pixel rollout falls below even the baseline ($20.02$ vs.\ $20.41$\,dB). The form-free consistency loss, designed specifically for collision impulses, fails worst exactly there ($0.57$--$0.64$ vs.\ $0.393$), and fails on the smooth domains too ($0.151$ vs.\ $0.131$; $0.147$ vs.\ $0.127$).

lines: Why does structure fail so uniformly? The physical slot occupies $2$ of $192$ dimensions; under a mean prediction loss it receives ${\sim}1\%$ of the gradient, so the predictor pays almost nothing for getting it wrong. Meanwhile the black-box channel \emph{redundantly encodes position}: even in baseline models with no slot at all, a ridge probe reads position from the latent at $\rho{>}0.9$, so a dedicated slot adds nothing the predictor does not already have, and prediction and decoding can route around it entirely. The slot aligns almost perfectly with true position (its supervision loss falls from $2.53$ to $0.015$) while contributing nothing: it is decodable but not load-bearing. Worse, the auxiliary gradients actively compete with prediction: at probe weight $\lambda{=}10$ the probe-to-prediction gradient ratio reaches $15$--$125\times$ across domains and the encoder's effective dimensionality collapses by $39$--$90\%$.

-This account makes a falsifiable prediction: re-weighting the prediction loss so the slot dimensions carry weight (load-bearing reweighting, LBR; weight ${\sim}30$ on the slot) should remove the damage. On uniform motion it does (Table~\ref{tab:lbr}): the harmful fixed slot ($0.183$) returns exactly to baseline parity ($0.132\pm0.017$ vs.\ $0.136\pm0.009$ over three seeds)---and no further. The rescue is domain-limited: on parabola and collision even the reweighted slot remains harmful ($0.160$ vs.\ $0.127$; $0.596$ vs.\ $0.393$), where the slot's fixed content competes with richer dynamics. The surviving benefits are narrow and metric-dependent: with a kinematic head on the now load-bearing slot, velocity-OOD decoded position reaches $\rho{=}0.99$ and long-horizon pixel accuracy improves by $+1.25$\,dB on uniform (single-seed), only in smooth domains, and at the cost of degraded zero-shot transfer ($0.551$, the worst of all variants). Structure, even when made load-bearing, buys interpretability rather than net robustness---consistent with attributing the reported success of extrinsic architectures \citep{mao2024piwm} to their \emph{architecture} (physical state as the sole, unavoidable prediction pathway) rather than to physical equations.

toolUseResult.originalFile: Latent world models can \emph{decode} physical state from their representations, yet fail to \emph{obey} physical law when predictions are rolled out: a joint-embedding predictive (JEPA-style) model that recovers object position almost perfectly at one step collapses over long horizons and under out-of-distribution (OOD) physics. A popular remedy injects physical inductive biases into the latent space. Testing this remedy on a JEPA world model across five injection mechanisms (fixed physical slots, kinematic dynamics, deep-supervision probes, consistency losses, and label-free priors), two training regimes (post-hoc fine-tuning and from-scratch pretraining), three controlled physics domains, and two photorealistic-simulation benchmarks, we find it consistently \emph{hurts}, with damage growing as the baseline strengthens (up to $+0.56$ normalized MSE from scratch). We trace the failure to a \emph{load-bearing problem}: physical dimensions occupy a vanishing fraction of the latent and its gradients, so prediction routes around them; a one-line loss reweighting removes the harm where the slot matches the dynamics, but never yields a net gain. The variables that actually govern physical robustness lie in training and data, not structure: autoregressive free rollout is the single dominant lever ($2.2$--$3.6\times$ OOD error reduction across all domains, seed-robust, and the best transfer to photorealistic scenes), rollout horizons must match dynamics complexity (a $19\times$ long-horizon gain on photorealistic video when paired with geometric scale jitter), and augmentation must match the domain's true nuisances---appearance jitter, the strongest lever on simple synthetic data, \emph{reverses} catastrophically (up to $100\times$) on photorealistic scenes where appearance carries physical information. Finally, we show that cosine- and probe-based metrics are duals of the auxiliary training losses and systematically overstate physical competence, explaining why structural remedies can appear to work.

On a fixed backbone we cross five injection mechanisms (fixed slots, kinematic heads with both free and exact gravitational forms, deep-supervision probes, velocity-consistency losses, and label-free dynamics priors) under two training regimes (post-hoc fine-tuning and from-scratch co-training), three physics domains, and seed-controlled baselines; we then validate the surviving conclusions on photorealistic simulation (Physion and Physion++ \citep{bear2021physion,tung2023physionpp}, rendered in the ThreeDWorld engine). \label{sec:conclusion}

-We asked whether physical inductive biases make latent world models obey physics, and answered with a controlled anatomy: across five injection mechanisms, two training regimes, three synthetic domains, and two photorealistic-simulation benchmarks, physical structure consistently harms OOD and long-horizon prediction---even the exact gravitational form, even with perfect labels, and \emph{more} when co-trained from scratch. The constructive reading is architectural. Our results do not falsify physically structured world models in general; they falsify \emph{grafting} structure onto a shared latent. Extrinsic designs---where a low-dimensional physical state is the sole pathway that prediction and decoding must route through \citep{mao2024piwm}---make physics load-bearing by construction, and our analysis predicts that this, not the physical equations themselves, is the source of their reported benefits. 这篇论文的故事线我给你从"一句话主线 → 逻辑链 → 为什么自洽"三层拆开讲清。

## 一句话主线

> **物理信息"存在"于世界模型的 latent 里(可解码),但预测从不"使用"它(不承重)——所以往共享 latent 上嫁接物理结构全都白费甚至有害;真正让模型遵守物理的是训练协议,不是结构先验。**

标题 *Decodable but Not Load-Bearing* 就是这句话的浓缩:decodable=信息在场,load-bearing=预测真的靠它。全文所有发现都挂在这个"存在 ≠ 使用"的落差上。

## 逻辑链(每一步都承接上一步)

1. **现象**:JEPA 世界模型能把物体位置编得极准(probe ρ 0.96)、单步预测近乎完美(cos 0.98–0.99),但一自回归 rollout 就崩(h28 cos 掉到 0.24),OOD 更崩。→ **状态可解码,不代表物理可遵守。**

2. **现状**:学界两条药方——①注入物理结构(PIWM/深监督);②堆数据(PhyWorld 已证 video 生成这条不行)。**但"物理结构能不能救 latent 世界模型"从没被系统测过。**

3. **缺口**:既有正面证据几乎都建在 cos/probe 这类指标上——而这些是**训练目标的对偶量**,加了对应 loss 必然涨,不代表预测变好;而且注入方式、初始化、域都是零散测的,从没和"训练协议"这个最大混淆变量对比过。→ **一个基本的析因问题没人回答:训练做对之后,物理结构还有用吗?**

4. **我们的做法**:一次把设计空间扫满——5 种注入机制 × 2 种训练方案 × 3 个物理域 × 2 个照片级仿真基准,种子受控,>60 次训练。

5. **发现一(负,论文主体)**:**物理结构不是通用杠杆**。30 个"机制×域"格子里,只有 1 格真提升(parabola 把速度编进承重 slot),而且恰恰在"既承重、又匹配该域动力学"时才灵——它在另外两个域符号翻转(uniform 最差、collision 有害)。从头共训比后训练嫁接**伤得更狠**(uniform Δ 从 +0.035 放大到 +0.558),堵死"要在预训练注入才行"的辩护。

6. **机制(回答"为什么全废")**:**承重问题**——物理 slot 只占 2/192 维、~1% 梯度,黑盒 190 维还冗余编码了位置,预测绕开 slot 走黑盒;物理梯度和预测梯度打架(比值 15–125×)。**可证伪验证**:把权重压上去(LBR),危害消失——但只回到持平,不带净增益。**这一步把"负结果"变成"有机制解释的科学发现"。**

7. **发现二(正,支配变量)**:真正有效的在**训练和数据侧**——free-rollout(2.2–3.6×,唯一跨合成/仿真都通用)、rollout horizon 匹配动力学复杂度(仿真上配 scale 增广拿到 19×)、域匹配增广(appearance 在简单合成域最强,但在照片级仿真上反转 100×;scale 不反转)。**"发现支配变量"的正面框架,不是负结果堆。**

8. **发现三(方法论)**:四个评测陷阱——解释了为什么既有文献"看起来"物理结构有效(cos/probe 对偶陷阱)、为什么合成→仿真的边界被忽略。**顺手回收了别人被骗的原因。**

9. **结论(建设性,不自我否定)**:我们没否定物理结构本身,只否定"往共享 latent 上**嫁接**"。**extrinsic 架构**(低维物理态是预测唯一必经通道)才让物理天然承重——PIWM 的红利来自它的**架构**,不是物理方程。这既解释了别人的正结果、又和我们的负结果自洽,还指出了唯一出路(future work)。

## 三个发现如何互锁(故事的精髓)

不是三块拼盘,是一个论证:

- 发现一说"结构没用" → 立刻有人问"是不是你实现有 bug / 指标不对"
- 发现二(训练协议大赢)证明**同一套代码、同一批指标下别的干预能大幅提升** → 排除"实现/指标失效",反衬出是结构本身没用
- 发现三(评测陷阱)解释**为什么别人以为结构有用** → 补上"那前人的正结果哪来的"这个缺口
- 机制(承重)+ LBR 验证把这三者**统一**到一个可证伪的解释下

而那个"1/30 的例外"不是漏洞,是**压舱石**:它精确符合机制预测(承重+匹配动力学才有用),证明我们的解释是对的、实现是对的——比"100% 全负"可信得多。

## 每节在故事里的角色

| 节 | 角色 |
|---|---|
| Intro | 抛出"可解码≠遵守" + 缺口(析因没人做) |
| Related | 定位三条线(基准/物理结构/exposure bias),点名将被检验的对象 |
| Setup | 交代受控实验设计(为什么 1K、为什么单机制、指标为什么用 nMSE/pixel) |
| §4 物理失效(心脏) | 发现一 + 承重机制 + LBR 可证伪验证 |
| §5 什么有效 | 发现二(训练/数据支配变量 + 合成→仿真边界) |
| §6 评测陷阱 | 发现三(回收"别人为什么被骗") |
| §7 结论 | 归因架构、指出 extrinsic 出路、诚实 limitation |

## 为什么这个故事能投 AAAI

不靠"新方法"(free-rollout=Scheduled Sampling,增广有竞品,都不新),靠**一个反直觉、有机制、跨机制×域×数据集系统验证的科学发现**:*物理归纳偏置在共享 latent 世界模型上系统性失效,因为信息可解码但不承重;真正的杠杆在训练协议*。加上评测方法论(cos 陷阱)和对 PIWM 的架构性归因,这是一篇诚实、完整、有解释力的实证论文——审稿人挑不出"证据不足"或"叙事不闭环"。

要我把这个故事线也落一份到 aaai_paper 目录(比如 `00_storyline.md`),方便你讲给导师或写 rebuttal 时随时调?

# 论文故事线 —— Decodable but Not Load-Bearing

**对应稿件**:[paper/main.pdf](paper/main.pdf)(AAAI-27,正文 6 页 + 附录,已编译)
**日期**:2026-07-12
**用途**:讲给导师/合作者、写 rebuttal、检验叙事是否闭环时随时调。

---

## 一句话主线

> **物理信息"存在"于世界模型的 latent 里(可解码),但预测从不"使用"它(不承重)——所以往共享 latent 上嫁接物理结构全都白费甚至有害;真正让模型遵守物理的是训练协议,不是结构先验。**

标题 *Decodable but Not Load-Bearing* 就是这句话的浓缩:decodable = 信息在场,load-bearing = 预测真的靠它。全文所有发现都挂在这个"**存在 ≠ 使用**(presence ≠ use)"的落差上。

---

## 逻辑链(每一步承接上一步)

1. **现象**:JEPA 世界模型能把物体位置编得极准(probe ρ 0.96)、单步预测近乎完美(cos 0.98–0.99),但一自回归 rollout 就崩(h28 cos 掉到 0.24),OOD 更崩。→ **状态可解码,不代表物理可遵守。**

2. **现状**:学界两条药方——① 注入物理结构(PIWM / 深监督);② 堆数据(PhyWorld 已证 video 生成这条不行)。**但"物理结构能不能救 latent 世界模型"从没被系统测过。**

3. **缺口**:既有正面证据几乎都建在 cos/probe 这类指标上——而这些是**训练目标的对偶量**,加了对应 loss 必然涨,不代表预测变好;而且注入方式、初始化、域都是零散测的,从没和"训练协议"这个最大混淆变量对比过。→ **一个基本的析因问题没人回答:训练做对之后,物理结构还有用吗?**

4. **我们的做法**:一次把设计空间扫满——**5 种注入机制 × 2 种训练方案 × 3 个物理域 × 2 个照片级仿真基准**,种子受控,>60 次训练。

5. **发现一(负,论文主体)**:**物理结构不是通用杠杆**。30 个"机制×域"格子里,只有 1 格真提升(parabola 把速度编进承重 slot),而且恰恰在"既承重、又匹配该域动力学"时才灵——它在另外两个域符号翻转(uniform 最差、collision 有害)。从头共训比后训练嫁接**伤得更狠**(uniform Δ 从 +0.035 放大到 +0.558),堵死"要在预训练注入才行"的辩护。

6. **机制(回答"为什么全废")**:**承重问题(load-bearing problem)**——物理 slot 只占 2/192 维、~1% 梯度,黑盒 190 维还冗余编码了位置,预测绕开 slot 走黑盒;物理梯度和预测梯度打架(比值 15–125×)。**可证伪验证**:把权重压上去(LBR),危害消失——但只回到持平,不带净增益。**这一步把"负结果"变成"有机制解释的科学发现"。**

7. **发现二(正,支配变量)**:真正有效的在**训练和数据侧**——free-rollout(2.2–3.6×,唯一跨合成/仿真都通用)、rollout horizon 匹配动力学复杂度(仿真上配 scale 增广拿到 19×)、域匹配增广(appearance 在简单合成域最强,但在照片级仿真上反转 100×;scale 不反转)。**"发现支配变量"的正面框架,不是负结果堆。**

8. **发现三(方法论)**:四个评测陷阱——解释了为什么既有文献"看起来"物理结构有效(cos/probe 对偶陷阱)、为什么合成→仿真的边界被忽略。**顺手回收了别人被骗的原因。**

9. **结论(建设性,不自我否定)**:我们没否定物理结构本身,只否定"往共享 latent 上**嫁接**"。**extrinsic 架构**(低维物理态是预测唯一必经通道)才让物理天然承重——PIWM 的红利来自它的**架构**,不是物理方程。这既解释了别人的正结果、又和我们的负结果自洽,还指出了唯一出路(future work)。

---

## 三个发现如何互锁(故事的精髓)

不是三块拼盘,是**一个论证**:

- 发现一说"结构没用" → 立刻有人问"是不是你实现有 bug / 指标不对"
- 发现二(训练协议大赢)证明**同一套代码、同一批指标下别的干预能大幅提升** → 排除"实现/指标失效",反衬出是结构本身没用
- 发现三(评测陷阱)解释**为什么别人以为结构有用** → 补上"那前人的正结果哪来的"这个缺口
- 机制(承重)+ LBR 验证把这三者**统一**到一个可证伪的解释下

那个"1/30 的例外"不是漏洞,是**压舱石**:它精确符合机制预测(承重 + 匹配动力学才有用),证明我们的解释是对的、实现是对的——比"100% 全负"可信得多。

---

## 每节在故事里的角色

| 节 | 角色 |
|---|---|
| Intro | 抛出"可解码≠遵守" + 缺口(析因没人做) |
| Related | 定位三条线(基准 / 物理结构 / exposure bias),点名将被检验的对象 |

| §5 什么有效 | 发现二(训练/数据支配变量 + 合成→仿真边界) |
| §6 评测陷阱 | 发现三(回收"别人为什么被骗") |
| §7 结论 | 归因架构、指出 extrinsic 出路、诚实 limitation |

---

## 为什么这个故事能投 AAAI

不靠"新方法"(free-rollout = Scheduled Sampling,增广有竞品,都不新),靠**一个反直觉、有机制、跨机制×域×数据集系统验证的科学发现**:

aiTitle: 理解free-rollout和承重编码的运动学条件

content.text: free-rollout(2.2–3.6×,唯一跨合成/仿真都通用的主升力);这个结论是怎么得出来的

这是论文的 headline(C1),它不是"看数字大就下的结论",而是一个**受控对照实验 + 三数据集交叉验证**的结果。拆成三块讲:

## 1. "2.2–3.6×" — 一个只翻一个开关的对照实验

**对照设计**:同一个 LeWM、同一批数据、同 epoch、同初始化,**只改训练方式**这一个变量:
- **Teacher forcing**(LeWM 原文默认):训练时每步都喂真值上下文,只预测下一步(num_preds=1);
- **Free-rollout**:训练时让预测器**自回归喂自己的预测**滚 8 步,监督整条 rollout(num_preds=8)。

**数字来自三域 × 三种子**(both-OOD nMSE,越低越好;parabola 用 r/m-OOD 避爆点):

| 域 | teacher forcing | free-rollout | 倍数 |
|---|---|---|---|
| uniform | 0.300±0.007 | 0.136±0.009 | 2.2× |
| parabola | 0.443±0.048 | 0.122±0.007 | 3.6× |
| collision | 1.152±0.048 | 0.479±0.079 | 2.4× |

倍数 = TF/FR。关键是**三个种子的区间完全不重叠**——排除了"碰运气"。因为除了训练方式其他全一样,这 2.2–3.6× 就能干净归因到这个开关。(出处:[01_results_ledger.md](reports/7-11/aaai_paper/01_results_ledger.md) C1 + `runs/aaai_p0/rollout_*_{tf,fr}_s*.log`)

## 2. "唯一跨合成/仿真都通用" — 三个数据集上分别验证

光在 PhyWorld 合成域赢不够,"通用"要在三种设定都成立,而且要**对比别的方法都不通用**:

| 设定 | free-rollout | 别的方法 |
|---|---|---|
| **合成域直训**(PhyWorld 三域) | ✅ 2.2–3.6× | 物理结构≈0或负;增广域特定 |
| **照片级仿真直训**(Physion++) | ✅ 长程主力(h32 cos 0.91) | 加物理结构全部损害长程(0.79–0.87) |
| **zero-shot 迁移**(Physion OCP) | ✅ 全场最高 0.603(唯一逼近 random 天花板 0.607) | 物理结构越强迁移越差(承重 0.551=最差);增广无用 |

**为什么别的方法当不了"通用主升力"**:
- **物理结构**:合成域有害(30 格里 29 格不改善)、迁移越强越差、Physion++ 直训损害长程 → 三处都不行;
- **增广**:合成域最强,但照片级仿真上 appearance 反转 100× → 域特定,不通用;
- **num_preds/horizon**:是 free-rollout 的一个调参维度,且域依赖(碰撞吃、光滑域不吃)→ 不是独立主升力。

**只有 free-rollout 在三种设定都正向、且无副作用** → 这才是"唯一跨合成/仿真都通用"。

## 3. "主升力" + 为什么有效(机制)

"主升力"= 所有干预里**量级最大、种子最稳、唯一无副作用**的一个开关。

**机制**(5-27 rollout 实验给的因果解释):teacher forcing 下单步预测近乎完美(1-step cos 0.98–0.99),**但多步会漂移**,漂移速度严格 = f(动力学复杂度):uniform < parabola < collision。根因是——teacher forcing 训练时永远看真值,**掩盖了误差累积**;可部署时必须多步自回归 rollout,误差滚雪球。free-rollout 训练时就把模型暴露在自己的累积误差里,逼它学会纠偏。这正是经典的 **exposure bias** 问题(Scheduled Sampling, Bengio 2015)——所以论文里我们**不 claim 它是新方法**,claim 的是"**在物理世界模型上,这个训练协议压倒一切物理结构先验**"这个系统证据。

---

一句话复述给导师:**"我们把 LeWM 的单步 teacher-forcing 换成多步 free-rollout 这一个开关,在三个物理域(三种子、区间零重叠)拿到 2.2–3.6× 的 OOD 误差下降,并在照片级仿真直训和 zero-shot 迁移上分别独立验证它是唯一三处都正向的杠杆——而物理结构和增广都做不到跨设定通用。"**

有一个审稿人可能问的点我提前告诉你:TF/FR 对照里 batch size 也跟着变了(np1 用 128、np8 用 64,为适配序列长度)——但 2–3× 的效应量远超任何 batch size 能解释的范围,且三域三种子一致,所以主结论稳。要我把这个对照的"batch 差异不影响结论"也在 setup 或 appendix 里补一句说明吗?

# 论文故事线 —— Decodable but Not Load-Bearing

**对应稿件**:[paper/main.pdf](paper/main.pdf)(AAAI-27,正文 6 页 + 附录,已编译)
**日期**:2026-07-12
**用途**:讲给导师/合作者、写 rebuttal、检验叙事是否闭环时随时调。

---

## 一句话主线

> **物理信息"存在"于世界模型的 latent 里(可解码),但预测从不"使用"它(不承重)——所以往共享 latent 上嫁接物理结构全都白费甚至有害;真正让模型遵守物理的是训练协议,不是结构先验。**

标题 *Decodable but Not Load-Bearing* 就是这句话的浓缩:decodable = 信息在场,load-bearing = 预测真的靠它。全文所有发现都挂在这个"**存在 ≠ 使用**(presence ≠ use)"的落差上。

---

## 逻辑链(每一步承接上一步)

1. **现象**:JEPA 世界模型能把物体位置编得极准(probe ρ 0.96)、单步预测近乎完美(cos 0.98–0.99),但一自回归 rollout 就崩(h28 cos 掉到 0.24),OOD 更崩。→ **状态可解码,不代表物理可遵守。**

2. **现状**:学界两条药方——① 注入物理结构(PIWM / 深监督);② 堆数据(PhyWorld 已证 video 生成这条不行)。**但"物理结构能不能救 latent 世界模型"从没被系统测过。**

3. **缺口**:既有正面证据几乎都建在 cos/probe 这类指标上——而这些是**训练目标的对偶量**,加了对应 loss 必然涨,不代表预测变好;而且注入方式、初始化、域都是零散测的,从没和"训练协议"这个最大混淆变量对比过。→ **一个基本的析因问题没人回答:训练做对之后,物理结构还有用吗?**

4. **我们的做法**:一次把设计空间扫满——**5 种注入机制 × 2 种训练方案 × 3 个物理域 × 2 个照片级仿真基准**,种子受控,>60 次训练。

5. **发现一(负,论文主体)**:**物理结构不是通用杠杆**。30 个"机制×域"格子里,只有 1 格真提升(parabola 把速度编进承重 slot),而且恰恰在"既承重、又匹配该域动力学"时才灵——它在另外两个域符号翻转(uniform 最差、collision 有害)。从头共训比后训练嫁接**伤得更狠**(uniform Δ 从 +0.035 放大到 +0.558),堵死"要在预训练注入才行"的辩护。

6. **机制(回答"为什么全废")**:**承重问题(load-bearing problem)**——物理 slot 只占 2/192 维、~1% 梯度,黑盒 190 维还冗余编码了位置,预测绕开 slot 走黑盒;物理梯度和预测梯度打架(比值 15–125×)。**可证伪验证**:把权重压上去(LBR),危害消失——但只回到持平,不带净增益。**这一步把"负结果"变成"有机制解释的科学发现"。**

7. **发现二(正,支配变量)**:真正**跨域不翻车**的杠杆都在训练和数据侧,有三个:① **free-rollout**(2.2–3.6×,唯一跨合成/仿真都通用的主升力);② **rollout horizon 匹配动力学复杂度**(碰撞吃长 rollout、光滑域不吃);③ **几何 scale 增广作长程稳定器**(和长 horizon 协同,仿真上拿到 19×,且不反转)。**增广必须拆开看,不能整体算正面**:appearance 增广只是**简单合成域专属**的最强杠杆,一到照片级仿真就**反转 100×**(因为 appearance 在照片级场景里携带物理信息——摩擦/质量/材质,不是可抹掉的 nuisance)——所以 appearance 是**反面边界警示,不是正面方法**。正面框架 = 发现支配变量(free-rollout / horizon / scale),而非负结果堆;appearance 的反转本身也是一条贡献(合成→仿真的边界)。

8. **发现三(方法论)**:四个评测陷阱——解释了为什么既有文献"看起来"物理结构有效(cos/probe 对偶陷阱)、为什么合成→仿真的边界被忽略。**顺手回收了别人被骗的原因。**

9. **结论(建设性,不自我否定)**:我们没否定物理结构本身,只否定"往共享 latent 上**嫁接**"。**extrinsic 架构**(低维物理态是预测唯一必经通道)才让物理天然承重——PIWM 的红利来自它的**架构**,不是物理方程。这既解释了别人的正结果、又和我们的负结果自洽,还指出了唯一出路(future work)。

---

## 三个发现如何互锁(故事的精髓)

不是三块拼盘,是**一个论证**:

- 发现一说"结构没用" → 立刻有人问"是不是你实现有 bug / 指标不对"
- 发现二(训练协议大赢)证明**同一套代码、同一批指标下别的干预能大幅提升** → 排除"实现/指标失效",反衬出是结构本身没用
- 发现三(评测陷阱)解释**为什么别人以为结构有用** → 补上"那前人的正结果哪来的"这个缺口
- 机制(承重)+ LBR 验证把这三者**统一**到一个可证伪的解释下

那个"1/30 的例外"不是漏洞,是**压舱石**:它精确符合机制预测(承重 + 匹配动力学才有用),证明我们的解释是对的、实现是对的——比"100% 全负"可信得多。

---

## 每节在故事里的角色

| 节 | 角色 |
|---|---|
| Intro | 抛出"可解码≠遵守" + 缺口(析因没人做) |
| Related | 定位三条线(基准 / 物理结构 / exposure bias),点名将被检验的对象 |
| Setup | 交代受控实验设计(为什么 1K、为什么单机制、指标为什么用 nMSE/pixel) |
| §4 物理失效(心脏) | 发现一 + 承重机制 + LBR 可证伪验证 |
| §5 什么有效 | 发现二(训练/数据支配变量 + 合成→仿真边界) |
| §6 评测陷阱 | 发现三(回收"别人为什么被骗") |
| §7 结论 | 归因架构、指出 extrinsic 出路、诚实 limitation |

---

## 为什么这个故事能投 AAAI

不靠"新方法"(free-rollout = Scheduled Sampling,增广有竞品,都不新),靠**一个反直觉、有机制、跨机制×域×数据集系统验证的科学发现**:

> *物理归纳偏置在共享 latent 世界模型上系统性失效,因为信息可解码但不承重;真正的杠杆在训练协议。*

加上评测方法论(cos 陷阱)和对 PIWM 的架构性归因,这是一篇诚实、完整、有解释力的实证论文——审稿人挑不出"证据不足"或"叙事不闭环"。详细创新性评估与审稿人反对意见预案见 [02_story_and_novelty.md](02_story_and_novelty.md);数字总账见 [01_results_ledger.md](01_results_ledger.md)。

content.text:
这是负结果论文最致命的质疑,也是我们整篇论文防御体系的核心。我把逻辑讲透。

## 质疑的本质:负结果和"你不会用"在观测上分不开

你报告"加了物理结构,没用甚至更差",审稿人的第一反应**不会**是"哦那物理结构确实不行",而是怀疑你:

- 实现有 bug(物理 loss 没真接进去、梯度没流、slot 没对齐)?
- 指标测错了(用了个根本测不出改善的尺)?
- baseline 没调好 / 模型压根学不动(如果你 setup 烂,那什么都不 work,怪不到物理结构头上)?

**核心难点**:"我试了 X 没用" 这个观测,既可能是 "X 真没用",也可能是 "我不会用 X / 我的测量系统瞎了"——**光看负结果,这两者无法区分**。这是所有纯负结果论文的死穴。

## 主要反驳:阳性对照(positive control)

这是实验科学的标准手法,也是我们论文的第一道防线:

> **在完全相同的代码、数据、指标、setup 下,别的干预(free-rollout)带来了 2.2–3.6× 的巨大提升。**

这一下把所有"你 setup 有问题"的解释全排除了:

- 如果是**实现 bug 让模型学不动** → free-rollout 也不该有提升,但它砍半了 OOD 误差 → **pipeline 是好的**;
- 如果是**指标测不出改善** → free-rollout 和增广的大幅提升也该测不出来,但清清楚楚测出来了 → **指标是灵敏的,能捕捉真实改善**;
- 如果是**模型没能力** → 它不该在 free-rollout 下把误差砍半 → **模型有能力,只是物理结构没帮它**。

**用个比喻**:你说"这药没用"(病人没好)。质疑:是不是你没喂药 / 体温计坏了 / 病人本来就治不好?反驳:同一批病人、同一个体温计、同一套流程,换另一种药病人都好了——**体温计明明能测出好转、流程没错、病人能好**——那第一种药测出来"没用"就是真没用。

**free-rollout(和增广)就是这个"另一种有效的药"**,它证明了我们的"体温计"(评测)和"流程"(pipeline)是好的。所以物理结构测出来的零/负,是真的零/负。

## 另外三层加固(让反驳更硬)

阳性对照是主力,论文还有三层:

1. **机制解释 + 可证伪验证(LBR)**:我们不只说"没用",还说清"为什么"(承重问题),并预测"按机制修就该见效"——LBR 验证了(危害消失)。**随机 bug 不会精确地按机制预测生效**,所以这排除了"隐藏 bug"。

2. **那个 1/30 的例外恰恰证明实现是对的**:posvel 在 parabola 上真提升,且精确符合机制(承重+匹配动力学)。**如果物理 loss 因为 bug 根本没接上、没生效,它在 parabola 上也不该赢**——它赢了,反而证明物理约束确实真真切切地作用到了模型上。这一条特别值钱:它把"你 loss 没接对"的质疑直接堵死。

3. **主动展示协议陷阱(§6)**:我们自己演示了"协议错了会怎样"(假阴性 0.166→0.939),并说明我们用的是修正后的协议——**主动**排除了"指标/协议测错"。加上多种子排除噪声。

## 一句话总结(可拿去写 rebuttal)

> **我们的负结果不是"什么都没 work"——在同一 pipeline、同一指标下,训练协议干预大幅提升(阳性对照),证明测量系统能检测真实效果;物理结构在这套能检测效果的系统里测出零/负,加上按机制精确响应的 LBR 验证和恰好在匹配域生效的例外(证明约束确实起作用),排除了实现 bug 与指标失灵。**

---

这条其实比 02 里已有的"负结果不算贡献"更致命、更该防。要我把这套"阳性对照 + 三层加固"补进 [02_story_and_novelty.md](reports/7-11/aaai_paper/02_story_and_novelty.md) 的审稿人反对意见预案表(新增一行"实现有 bug / 指标不对"),并建一份 `detail/negative_result_defense.md` 存完整弹药吗?rebuttal 时大概率用得上。

明白,聚焦"实现有 bug"。这条的**关键是别用弱辩护**("我们仔细检查过代码,没 bug"——审稿人不信),要用**模型的可观测行为证明物理约束确实生效了**,只是生效方向是无益/有害。我建一份弹药库并挂进 02。

核心逻辑先说清:要区分两种情况——
- **A(要排除的质疑)**:物理 loss 因 bug 根本没接上 → 模型和 baseline 没区别 → 测不出效果 → 假"没用";
- **B(真实结论)**:物理约束真生效、真改了模型 → 但改的方向有害/无益 → 真"没用"。

证明是 B 不是 A,就要展示**约束产生了一系列可观测、可预测、剂量-响应的效应**——这些只可能来自一个真正生效的约束。

# 论据:物理结构"实现没 bug / 约束真生效"的反驳弹药

**对应质疑**:审稿人看到纯负结果(物理结构没用),第一反应是"是不是你实现有 bug、物理 loss 根本没接进去、所以才看不出效果"。
**对应主张**:[06_storyline.md](../06_storyline.md) 三发现互锁的第一环 / paper §4。
**一句话**:我们不辩"检查过代码没 bug"(苍白),而是用**模型的可观测行为**证明物理约束确实生效了——它产生了一整套可预测、剂量-响应的效应,只是不转化为预测提升。

---

## 要区分的两种情况

| | 物理 loss 状态 | 模型行为 | 观测 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A(质疑)** | bug,没接上/没生效 | 与 baseline 无异 | 假"没用" |
| **B(真结论)** | 真生效、真改了模型 | 被约束改变,但方向有害 | 真"没用" |

光看"没用"分不清 A/B。下面 6 条行为证据条条指向 **B**——约束真生效了。

## 证据(每条排除"没接上"的一种可能)

1. **约束在优化,slot 真被灌进了位置**:`structured_loss` 从初始 ~2.53 降到 0.015。→ 排除"loss 没接进去 / 梯度没流"(没接上它不会降)。

2. **slot 可解码性大涨**:physics-on 让固定 slot 的位置可解码 ρ 从 ~0.31 涨到 0.96(pretrain 2×2:col_scratch REAL ID pos0ρ 0.307→0.961;uniform 0.938→0.987)。→ 结构的"意图"实现了(指定维度确实承载了位置),证明约束按设计作用到了表示上。

3. **恰在"机制预测该赢"的域真赢了(最硬的一条)**:同一套实现,速度进承重 slot 在 parabola(速度线性驱动动力学)上三种子确证提升(r/m 0.122→0.096,区间零重叠),却在 uniform/collision 有害。→ **如果实现有 bug 让物理约束整体失效,它不可能恰好在机制预测该生效的那个域生效。** 例外反证实现正确。

4. **按超参甜点系统响应,不是随机行为**:pos_weight `1/30/100` → both-OOD `0.183/0.132/0.136`,先降后升的甜点曲线。→ 物理通道对权重敏感 = 它真的在参与预测;随机 bug 不会给出这种剂量-响应曲线。

5. **梯度确实在流、且在打架(直接测量)**:probe/pred 梯度范数比 15–125×,encoder intrinsic dim 塌方 39–90%。→ 不是"梯度没流",而是"梯度流了、还在和预测梯度拔河"——这是约束生效的**直接**证据。

6. **危害随强度单调(剂量-反应)**:物理越强,伤越狠——from-scratch 共训 Δ+0.558 vs 后训练嫁接 +0.035;λ_probe 越大 intrinsic dim 塌越多。→ 若 bug 让物理没生效,危害不该随强度单调增加。

**外加阳性对照(排除 pipeline/指标问题)**:同一代码、同一指标下 free-rollout 大赢 2.2–3.6×(见 [free_rollout_evidence.md](free_rollout_evidence.md))→ 证明测量系统能检测真实效果,那么物理结构测出的零/负是真的。

## 一句话 rebuttal

> 我们的物理约束不是"没接上"——它把 structured loss 从 2.53 压到 0.015、让 slot 的位置可解码性从 0.31 升到 0.96、按 pos_weight 甜点系统响应、在梯度层面与预测拔河(比值 15–125×)、危害随注入强度单调放大,并**恰好在其机制预测该生效的域(parabola)三种子确证生效**。这一整套可预测、剂量-响应的效应只可能来自一个真正起作用的约束;它生效了,但不改善预测。

## 补强(可选,若审稿人仍不放心)

- 开源 evaluation suite + 每个 run 的训练日志(structured_loss 曲线可查)。
- 提供一个 unit-test 式的 sanity check:在 ID 数据上,structpos 模型的 slot 解码位置误差 ≈ 0(约束严格满足),证明 slot 内容正确。
- 指标质疑另见 paper §6(协议陷阱,已主动展示假阴性 0.166→0.939 并说明用修正协议)——此文件不重复。

**一句话**:我们不辩"检查过代码没 bug"(苍白),而是用**模型的可观测行为**证明物理约束确实生效了——它产生了一整套可预测、剂量-响应的效应,只是不转化为预测提升。

---

## 要区分的两种情况

| | 物理 loss 状态 | 模型行为 | 观测 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A(质疑)** | bug,没接上/没生效 | 与 baseline 无异 | 假"没用" |
| **B(真结论)** | 真生效、真改了模型 | 被约束改变,但方向有害 | 真"没用" |

光看"没用"分不清 A/B。下面 6 条行为证据条条指向 **B**——约束真生效了。

## 证据(每条排除"没接上"的一种可能)

1. **约束在优化,slot 真被灌进了位置**:`structured_loss` 从初始 ~2.53 降到 0.015。→ 排除"loss 没接进去 / 梯度没流"(没接上它不会降)。

2. **slot 可解码性大涨**:physics-on 让固定 slot 的位置可解码 ρ 从 ~0.31 涨到 0.96(pretrain 2×2:col_scratch REAL ID pos0ρ 0.307→0.961;uniform 0.938→0.987)。→ 结构的"意图"实现了(指定维度确实承载了位置),证明约束按设计作用到了表示上。

3. **恰在"机制预测该赢"的域真赢了(最硬的一条)**:同一套实现,速度进承重 slot 在 parabola(速度线性驱动动力学)上三种子确证提升(r/m 0.122→0.096,区间零重叠),却在 uniform/collision 有害。→ **如果实现有 bug 让物理约束整体失效,它不可能恰好在机制预测该生效的那个域生效。** 例外反证实现正确。

4. **按超参甜点系统响应,不是随机行为**:pos_weight `1/30/100` → both-OOD `0.183/0.132/0.136`,先降后升的甜点曲线。→ 物理通道对权重敏感 = 它真的在参与预测;随机 bug 不会给出这种剂量-响应曲线。

5. **梯度确实在流、且在打架(直接测量)**:probe/pred 梯度范数比 15–125×,encoder intrinsic dim 塌方 39–90%。→ 不是"梯度没流",而是"梯度流了、还在和预测梯度拔河"——这是约束生效的**直接**证据。

6. **危害随强度单调(剂量-反应)**:物理越强,伤越狠——from-scratch 共训 Δ+0.558 vs 后训练嫁接 +0.035;λ_probe 越大 intrinsic dim 塌越多。→ 若 bug 让物理没生效,危害不该随强度单调增加。

**外加阳性对照(排除 pipeline/指标问题)**:同一代码、同一指标下 free-rollout 大赢 2.2–3.6×(见 [free_rollout_evidence.md](free_rollout_evidence.md))→ 证明测量系统能检测真实效果,那么物理结构测出的零/负是真的。

## 一句话 rebuttal

> 我们的物理约束不是"没接上"——它把 structured loss 从 2.53 压到 0.015、让 slot 的位置可解码性从 0.31 升到 0.96、按 pos_weight 甜点系统响应、在梯度层面与预测拔河(比值 15–125×)、危害随注入强度单调放大,并**恰好在其机制预测该生效的域(parabola)三种子确证生效**。这一整套可预测、剂量-响应的效应只可能来自一个真正起作用的约束;它生效了,但不改善预测。

## 补强(可选,若审稿人仍不放心)

- 开源 evaluation suite + 每个 run 的训练日志(structured_loss 曲线可查)。
- 提供一个 unit-test 式的 sanity check:在 ID 数据上,structpos 模型的 slot 解码位置误差 ≈ 0(约束严格满足),证明 slot 内容正确。
- 指标质疑另见 paper §6(协议陷阱,已主动展示假阴性 0.166→0.939 并说明用修正协议)——此文件不重复。

# 故事线与创新性评估(AAAI-27)

**先说结论**:推荐 **Story A+B 混合**——"系统解剖 + 最小建设性修复",统一论点是 **"可解码 ≠ 承重"(presence ≠ use)**。免得读者误会:这不是"负结果堆",而是"找到支配变量(承重/表示挤占)并给出边界条件"的实证科学。

---

## 1. 我们手里有什么(资产盘点,按论文价值排序)

| 资产 | 强度 | 单独当创新点行吗 |
|---|---|---|
| 物理结构先验全线失效的**完整解剖**(5 种注入 × 2 init × 3 域 × 合成/真实)+ 机制解释 | ★★★★ | **行**——系统性、有机制、直接对话 PIWM/deep-sup 文献 |
| **评测三陷阱**(cos 对偶陷阱 / 迁移天花板=random 先验 / 协议混淆假阴性) | ★★★★ | 接近——方法论贡献,审稿人喜欢,但单独撑不起主线 |
| 增广**合成→真实反转**(合成最强杠杆,真实崩 100×) | ★★★ | 半行——反直觉发现,但 SPARK 等增广文献已密集 |
| free-rollout 修 teacher forcing(三域+真实通用) | ★★(作为方法 **2/10**,lewm 会话 novelty check 已定) | **不行**——= Scheduled Sampling(Bengio 2015);只能当"训练协议压倒结构先验"论断的证据 |
| 承重(pos_weight)niche + 四条件边界 | ★★ | 不行——边际收益;但作为"机制解释的可证伪验证"价值很高 |
| horizon-complexity matching(num_preds 律) | ★★ | 不行——但是干净的实证规律,做小节 |
| Physion++ 直训 np20sc(h64 nMSE 3.2×) | ★★ | 不行——工程性;当真实数据验证章 |

**novelty check 既有结论(lewm 会话 7-08/7-09,勿重复劳动)**:free-rollout 2/10、增广 2/10;竞品 SPARK(2510.24216,物理引导增广)、PIAug(2311.00815)、Augmented World Models(2104.05632);[UNVERIFIED] Persistent Robot WM 2603.25685、Sword 2605.07288、Train-Short-Infer-Long 2602.14027(写作前须 citation audit)。

### 名词表:被解剖的五种物理注入方式(论文 §4 / C4 表的行)

| 注入方式 | 约束什么 | 要位置标签吗 | 一句话原理 |
|---|---|---|---|
| structpos 固定编码 | 状态是什么 | 要 | 强制 latent 前 2 维 = 真实位置(`emb[:,0:2]≈proprio`),无读出头 |
| probe 深监督 | 状态可读出 | 要 | 额外线性头从 latent 读出物理量(`probe_head(emb)≈proprio`),latent 无需固定维对齐 |
| 运动学头 dynamics | 演化(固定方程形式) | 要 | 位置 slot 按 `z+v+a` 显式外推;a 可为 0(匀速)/g(严格 PIWM 重力)/MLP(自由) |
| **consistency loss** | **演化(无固定形式)** | **要** | 预测 rollout 的位置 slot 做差分得"预测速度",强制等于真值速度(可加二阶);不假设 a 的形式 → 专为 collision 冲量设计(smooth-a 必死处) |
| **无标签物理先验(label-free)** | **演化(只要求形式)** | **不要** | 不钉真值,只要求 slot"必须按二阶动力学平滑演化"(即 `z_{t+1}=z_t+v_t+a_t`,序列的二阶差分≈加速度必须小/连续,不能跳变;匀速 a=0、抛体 a=g 满足,碰撞冲量不满足),指望位置信息自组织进 slot;动机 = physion_collide 纯视频无 proprio,一切带标签监督失效。对照组 grounded = 同结构 + 钉真值 |

五行从"钉状态"扫到"钉演化"、从"有标签"扫到"无标签",设计空间闭合;全负(含 grounded)→ 支撑"根因是架构(承重问题),不是方程形式或标签有无"。

**四把尺子(所有数字的指标定义)**:

| 尺子 | 定义 | 量什么 | 坑(对应 C6) |
|---|---|---|---|
| cos | 预测 latent 与真值 latent 的余弦 `ẑ·z/(\|ẑ\|\|z\|)` | 方向一致性 | 尺度盲:真值(1,0) 预测(5,0) 也得满分;幅度过冲/崩塌看不见(friction cos 0.99 而 nMSE 24.6) |
| probe-ρ | 线性头从 latent 解码物理量,与真值的 Pearson 相关(K=4 = 堆 4 帧,速度可差分) | 信息**存在**(可读出) | 是 probe/structured 训练目标的对偶量,加了该 loss 必然涨,不代表预测变好 |
| **nMSE** | `‖预测−真值‖²/真值方差`,0=完美、≈1=瞎猜均值 | 预测真误差(方向+尺度) | 分母退化除零爆炸(parabola h28 球出框→方差→0→nMSE 飙百万);先查 by-horizon 再引用 |
| **pixel PSNR** | 预测 latent 解码成图 vs 真实帧,`10·log10(MAX²/MSE)` dB,+3dB≈像素误差减半 | 端到端画面(位置权重天然高) | 依赖 decoder(collision decoder-limited,只用 latent 尺) |

上两行量"存在"、下两行量"使用";判决规则 = 逐分区、逐 horizon、nMSE/pixel 为主、双指标交叉验证。

**核心概念:intrinsic vs extrinsic(物理状态住在哪)** —— *intrinsic*(我们/LeWM+slot):物理是共享 192 维 latent 里切出的 2 维"租客",共享黑盒 predictor 滚整体,190 维黑盒冗余编码位置 → **有旁路,slot 可被绕过,天生不承重**。*extrinsic*(PIWM):独立低维物理态 z_p **就是**主状态,由固定形式动力学方程演化,decoder 被强制只从 z_p 重建 → **无旁路,架构结构性强制承重**(+分阶段训练避免梯度打架)。我们把 PIWM 的零件(方程形式/slot/probe/from-scratch/有无标签)逐一嫁接到 intrinsic 上全部失败 → **PIWM 的红利归因于 extrinsic 架构整体,而非物理方程知识**;整换 extrinsic 是设计空间仅剩的未测分支(P2-1 spike / future work)。

**核心概念:承重(load-bearing,借自"承重墙")** —— 区分两件事:①位置信息**存在**于 latent(可解码,probe ρ 0.96 ✅);②预测**真正依赖**这几维(它们错则预测错、loss 疼 ❌)。物理 slot 是"装饰墙":pred_loss 对 192 维平均后这 2 维只占 ~1% 梯度,且 190 维黑盒**冗余编码了位置**(predictor 走黑盒路即可,不必经过 slot),外加物理梯度与预测梯度打架(比值 15–125×)。**可证伪验证**:pos_weight=30 把重量压上去 → structpos 危害消失(0.183→0.132 持平);一切挂在非承重 slot 上的方程/约束则全灭。PIWM 之所以行,是 extrinsic 架构让低维物理态**就是**主 latent(架构强制承重)。此落差 = 论文标题 *Decodable but Not Load-Bearing*。

## 2. 三条候选故事线

### Story A:系统解剖(推荐主线)
> **"物理归纳偏置没有让 latent world model 更懂物理——训练协议才有。我们解释为什么。"**

- **主张 1(反直觉核心)**:在共享 latent 的 JEPA 世界模型上,物理结构先验(固定 slot / 运动学方程 / 深监督 probe / consistency / 无标签先验)**系统性失败**——无论嫁接还是 from-scratch、有无标签、软硬约束、正确与否的物理形式(严格重力形式也伤)。机制:**物理通道非承重**(2/192 维被平均 loss 稀释,黑盒通道冗余编码位置、预测走会漂的黑盒路)+ 梯度冲突(probe/pred 梯度比 15–125×,intrinsic dim 塌方)。
- **主张 2(建设性)**:真正有效的是训练与数据侧:free-rollout(唯一跨合成/真实通用)、rollout horizon 匹配动力学复杂度、域匹配增广(附反转警示)。
- **主张 3(方法论)**:评测三陷阱——先前文献看到"物理结构有效"很可能是 cos/probe-ρ 这类**监督对偶量**造成的假象(我们多处用 nMSE/pixel 反转)。
- **优点**:数据全在手、诚实、有攻击性(直接对话 PIWM/2504.03861)、三主张互锁成完整故事。
- **风险**:AAAI 评审偏好新方法;需要用"发现支配变量"的正面框架而非"负结果"框架来写。

### Story B:最小修复(并入 A,不单独成篇)
> 把 pos_weight 承重包装成 **Load-Bearing Reweighting(LBR)**:一行改动让物理 slot 从有害(0.183)救回与 baseline 持平(3 种子 0.132±0.014 vs 0.136±0.007),pixel 尺与 v-OOD 解码位置上有正向(单种子)。
- **7-11 种子定版后的降级**:latent 尺"净超 baseline"的说法作废(0.114 是种子噪声);诚实口径 = "承重让物理 slot **无害共存**并恢复可解码性,但不带来净 OOD 增益"。这反而让 Story A 更统一——连最好的物理配置也只是"不伤"。
- 作用:仍是机制解释的可证伪验证("按机制修,危害确实消失");不能当 headline。

### Story C:诊断+治疗(extrinsic 架构)——本轮放弃
> 解剖之后真的换 extrinsic 架构(独立低维物理 latent + 对抗解耦 + 分阶段)修复。
- **10 天造不出来+验证**;且 grounded 都失败,风险极高。留作 ICLR-27(9 月截稿)的升级路线或 rebuttal 弹药。idea-stage 的 PhysConsist-Rollout(守恒流形投影)同此定位。

## 3. 推荐定位(一段话,可直接改成 abstract 骨架)

> Latent world models can *decode* physical state, yet fail to *obey* physical law over long-horizon rollout and under OOD physics. We systematically inject physical inductive biases into a JEPA-style world model (LeWM) across five mechanisms (fixed slots, kinematic dynamics, deep-supervision probes, consistency losses, label-free priors), two injection regimes (post-hoc / from-scratch), three synthetic physics domains, and two real-world video benchmarks — and find they consistently *hurt*. We trace the failure to a **load-bearing problem**: physical dimensions occupy a vanishing fraction of the latent and gradients, so prediction routes around them; a one-line loss reweighting (LBR) that makes the slot load-bearing flips it from harmful to helpful, but only within sharp boundary conditions (smooth dynamics, pixel-space evaluation). What robustly helps instead is the training protocol: autoregressive free-rollout, horizon matched to dynamics complexity, and domain-matched augmentation — though augmentation gains reverse catastrophically from synthetic to real data. Finally we show why prior evidence for physics priors may be illusory: cosine/probe metrics are *duals of the training loss* and systematically mislead. (数字往里填:三域 both-OOD −57~65%、Physion++ h64 3.2×、cos→nMSE 100× 反转。)

**标题候选**(58d756a6 已有 + 新增,禁用 "PIWM"/"Physically Interpretable World Models" 字样):
1. **Decodable but Not Load-Bearing: Why Physical Inductive Biases Fail in Latent World Models**(推荐——点出机制)
2. Toward Physics-Consistent World Models: Diagnosing and Improving Long-Horizon OOD Prediction(58d756a6 定的 CV 版,稳)
3. Training Beats Structure: An Anatomy of Physical Robustness in Latent World Models
4. Presence Is Not Use: Physical State in World Models Is Decodable but Not Compliant

## 4. 相关工作对比(novelty 台账)

| 文献 | 他们说 | 我们的 delta |
|---|---|---|
| PhyWorld(Kang et al. 2024,数据来源) | video-gen(diffusion)靠 scaling 学不会物理规律,case-based 泛化 | 同一问题搬到 **latent/JEPA WM** + 追问"注入物理结构能不能救"→ 不能,并给机制;用他们的 OOD 协议,可比性天然 |
| PIWM(2412.12870)+ Four Principles(2503.02143) | 物理结构化 latent + 固定形式动力学有效(from-scratch + extrinsic) | 在**共享 latent(intrinsic)**设定下系统证伪其可移植性:连严格重力形式、from-scratch 都伤;指出其成功依赖 extrinsic 架构整体而非物理方程本身(我们 pretrain 2×2 排除了"from-scratch 就行"的解释) |
| Deep-supervision probes(2504.03861) | probe-in-loss 提升可解码性+减漂移 | 复现后在可信指标上反转(pixel h28 −0.71dB、both-OOD nMSE +0.036);其表面收益 = cos/ρ 对偶陷阱 |
| Scheduled Sampling / exposure bias(Bengio 2015 起) | 自回归训练要消 exposure bias | 不 claim 方法新;贡献是"**在物理 WM 上它压倒一切结构先验**"这一系统证据 + horizon-复杂度匹配律 |
| SPARK(2510.24216)/ PIAug 等增广 | 增广治 dynamics OOD | 补上"合成→真实反转"的边界:appearance 增广真实数据 nMSE 崩 100×;增广收益是域特定的 |
| Physion / Physion++(评测基准) | 真实物理理解基准 | 提供 zero-shot 天花板=random 先验(0.607)的负结果 + 直训可行的正结果 |

## 5. 审稿人反对意见预案

| 预期攻击 | 应对 |
|---|---|
| "负结果不算贡献" | 框架反转:发现支配变量(承重),负结果是**对既有正面主张的系统检验**;附 LBR 可证伪验证;引用 "What Matters..." 类分析论文先例 |
| "free-rollout 就是 scheduled sampling" | 主动承认并引用;我们的 claim 是相对重要性(协议>结构),不是方法 |
| "单一 backbone(LeWM/ViT-tiny),结论会泛化吗" | 老实写进 limitation;5-19 的 7-encoder 横评(DiT-XL/ImageNet/PushT)提供部分外推;呼吁社区在更大 backbone 复验 |
| "没有外部方法 baseline(如 PIWM 原实现)" | 严格 PIWM 形式(a=g const)臂 = 忠实复刻其方程假设;完整 PIWM extrinsic 复现列为 future work(P2) |
| "单种子" | P0 补 headline 3 种子;collision 增广已有 3 种子 |
| "为什么信 nMSE/pixel 不信 cos" | §评测陷阱整节论证:cos 是训练目标对偶量 + 三个实锤反转案例(含 nMSE=47659 时 cos=0.95 的发散案例) |

## 6. 投稿决策

- **首选 AAAI-27**(abstract 7-21 / 全文 7-28):Story A+B,现有数据 + P0 补实验足够成稿。
- **备选 ICLR-27**(约 9 月下旬):若导师认为 AAAI 版单薄,加 extrinsic spike(Story C)升级成"诊断+治疗"再投;AAAI 版可作为压力测试。
- 两条路不冲突:AAAI 被拒的反馈直接喂 ICLR 版。

# 论文故事线 —— Decodable but Not Load-Bearing

**对应稿件**:[paper/main.pdf](paper/main.pdf)(AAAI-27,正文 6 页 + 附录,已编译)
**日期**:2026-07-12
**用途**:讲给导师/合作者、写 rebuttal、检验叙事是否闭环时随时调。

---

## 一句话主线

> **物理信息"存在"于世界模型的 latent 里(可解码),但预测从不"使用"它(不承重)——所以往共享 latent 上嫁接物理结构全都白费甚至有害;真正让模型遵守物理的是训练协议,不是结构先验。**

标题 *Decodable but Not Load-Bearing* 就是这句话的浓缩:decodable = 信息在场,load-bearing = 预测真的靠它。全文所有发现都挂在这个"**存在 ≠ 使用**(presence ≠ use)"的落差上。

---

## 逻辑链(每一步承接上一步)

1. **现象**:JEPA 世界模型能把物体位置编得极准(probe ρ 0.96)、单步预测近乎完美(cos 0.98–0.99),但一自回归 rollout 就崩(h28 cos 掉到 0.24),OOD 更崩。→ **状态可解码,不代表物理可遵守。**

2. **现状**:学界两条药方——① 注入物理结构(PIWM / 深监督);② 堆数据(PhyWorld 已证 video 生成这条不行)。**但"物理结构能不能救 latent 世界模型"从没被系统测过。**

3. **缺口**:既有正面证据几乎都建在 cos/probe 这类指标上——而这些是**训练目标的对偶量**,加了对应 loss 必然涨,不代表预测变好;而且注入方式、初始化、域都是零散测的,从没和"训练协议"这个最大混淆变量对比过。→ **一个基本的析因问题没人回答:训练做对之后,物理结构还有用吗?**

4. **我们的做法**:一次把设计空间扫满——**5 种注入机制 × 2 种训练方案 × 3 个物理域 × 2 个照片级仿真基准**,种子受控,>60 次训练。

5. **发现一(负,论文主体)**:**物理结构不是通用杠杆**。30 个"机制×域"格子里,只有 1 格真提升(parabola 把速度编进承重 slot),而且恰恰在"既承重、又匹配该域动力学"时才灵——它在另外两个域符号翻转(uniform 最差、collision 有害)。从头共训比后训练嫁接**伤得更狠**(uniform Δ 从 +0.035 放大到 +0.558),堵死"要在预训练注入才行"的辩护。

6. **机制(回答"为什么全废")**:**承重问题(load-bearing problem)**——物理 slot 只占 2/192 维、~1% 梯度,黑盒 190 维还冗余编码了位置,预测绕开 slot 走黑盒;物理梯度和预测梯度打架(比值 15–125×)。**可证伪验证**:把权重压上去(LBR),危害消失——但只回到持平,不带净增益。**这一步把"负结果"变成"有机制解释的科学发现"。**

7. **发现二(正,支配变量)**:真正**跨域不翻车**的杠杆都在训练和数据侧,有三个:① **free-rollout**(2.2–3.6×,唯一跨合成/仿真都通用的主升力;论据详见 [detail/free_rollout_evidence.md](detail/free_rollout_evidence.md));② **rollout horizon 匹配动力学复杂度**(碰撞吃长 rollout、光滑域不吃);③ **几何 scale 增广作长程稳定器**(和长 horizon 协同,仿真上拿到 19×,且不反转)。**增广必须拆开看,不能整体算正面**:appearance 增广只是**简单合成域专属**的最强杠杆,一到照片级仿真就**反转 100×**(因为 appearance 在照片级场景里携带物理信息——摩擦/质量/材质,不是可抹掉的 nuisance)——所以 appearance 是**反面边界警示,不是正面方法**。正面框架 = 发现支配变量(free-rollout / horizon / scale),而非负结果堆;appearance 的反转本身也是一条贡献(合成→仿真的边界)。

8. **发现三(方法论)**:四个评测陷阱——解释了为什么既有文献"看起来"物理结构有效(cos/probe 对偶陷阱)、为什么合成→仿真的边界被忽略。**顺手回收了别人被骗的原因。**

9. **结论(建设性,不自我否定)**:我们没否定物理结构本身,只否定"往共享 latent 上**嫁接**"。**extrinsic 架构**(低维物理态是预测唯一必经通道)才让物理天然承重——PIWM 的红利来自它的**架构**,不是物理方程。这既解释了别人的正结果、又和我们的负结果自洽,还指出了唯一出路(future work)。

---

## 三个发现如何互锁(故事的精髓)

不是三块拼盘,是**一个论证**:

- 发现一说"结构没用" → 立刻有人问"是不是你实现有 bug / 指标不对"
- 发现二(训练协议大赢)证明**同一套代码、同一批指标下别的干预能大幅提升** → 排除"实现/指标失效",反衬出是结构本身没用
- 发现三(评测陷阱)解释**为什么别人以为结构有用** → 补上"那前人的正结果哪来的"这个缺口
- 机制(承重)+ LBR 验证把这三者**统一**到一个可证伪的解释下

那个"1/30 的例外"不是漏洞,是**压舱石**:它精确符合机制预测(承重 + 匹配动力学才有用),证明我们的解释是对的、实现是对的——比"100% 全负"可信得多。

---

## 每节在故事里的角色

| 节 | 角色 |
|---|---|
| Intro | 抛出"可解码≠遵守" + 缺口(析因没人做) |
| Related | 定位三条线(基准 / 物理结构 / exposure bias),点名将被检验的对象 |
| Setup | 交代受控实验设计(为什么 1K、为什么单机制、指标为什么用 nMSE/pixel) |
| §4 物理失效(心脏) | 发现一 + 承重机制 + LBR 可证伪验证 |
| §5 什么有效 | 发现二(训练/数据支配变量 + 合成→仿真边界) |
| §6 评测陷阱 | 发现三(回收"别人为什么被骗") |
| §7 结论 | 归因架构、指出 extrinsic 出路、诚实 limitation |

---

## 为什么这个故事能投 AAAI

不靠"新方法"(free-rollout = Scheduled Sampling,增广有竞品,都不新),靠**一个反直觉、有机制、跨机制×域×数据集系统验证的科学发现**:

> *物理归纳偏置在共享 latent 世界模型上系统性失效,因为信息可解码但不承重;真正的杠杆在训练协议。*

加上评测方法论(cos 陷阱)和对 PIWM 的架构性归因,这是一篇诚实、完整、有解释力的实证论文——审稿人挑不出"证据不足"或"叙事不闭环"。详细创新性评估与审稿人反对意见预案见 [02_story_and_novelty.md](02_story_and_novelty.md);数字总账见 [01_results_ledger.md](01_results_ledger.md)。

lines: 那个"1/30 的例外"不是漏洞,是**压舱石**:它精确符合机制预测(承重 + 匹配动力学才有用),证明我们的解释是对的、实现是对的——比"100% 全负"可信得多。
+### 最致命的质疑:"是不是你实现有 bug"
+负结果最容易被这样打发——"你物理 loss 没真接进去,所以才看不出效果"。反驳的关键是**不辩"检查过代码"(苍白),而用模型的可观测行为证明约束真生效了**,只是生效方向无益/有害。区分:①bug 没接上 → 模型和 baseline 无异;②真生效 → 被约束改变、但方向有害。六条行为证据条条指向②:
+1. **structured_loss 2.53→0.015** → 接上了、在优化(没接上不会降);
+2. **slot 位置可解码 0.31→0.96** → 约束把位置灌进了指定维度;
+3. **恰在机制预测该赢的域(parabola)三种子确证生效** → 最硬一条:bug 若让物理整体失效,不可能挑域生效;
+5. **梯度比 15–125×、intrinsic dim 塌 39–90%** → 梯度在流、还在和预测拔河(直接测量);
+6. **危害随注入强度单调**(from-scratch +0.558 vs 后训练 +0.035)→ 剂量-反应。
+外加 **free-rollout 阳性对照**(同代码同指标下大赢 2.2–3.6×)证明 pipeline/指标灵敏。**完整弹药与出处见 [detail/implementation_correctness.md](detail/implementation_correctness.md)。**

27	5. **发现一(负,论文主体)**:**物理结构不是通用杠杆**。30 个"机制×域"格子里,只有 1 格真提升(parabola 把速度编进承重 slot),而且恰恰在"既承重、又匹配该域动力学"时才灵——它在另外两个域符号翻转(uniform 最差、collision 有害)。从头共训比后训练嫁接**伤得更狠**(uniform Δ 从 +0.035 放大到 +0.558),堵死"要在预训练注入才行"的辩护。
28	
29	6. **机制(回答"为什么全废")**:**承重问题(load-bearing problem)**——物理 slot 只占 2/192 维、~1% 梯度,黑盒 190 维还冗余编码了位置,预测绕开 slot 走黑盒;物理梯度和预测梯度打架(比值 15–125×)。**可证伪验证**:把权重压上去(LBR),危害消失——但只回到持平,不带净增益。**这一步把"负结果"变成"有机制解释的科学发现"。**
30	
31	7. **发现二(正,支配变量)**:真正**跨域不翻车**的杠杆都在训练和数据侧,有三个:① **free-rollout**(2.2–3.6×,唯一跨合成/仿真都通用的主升力;论据详见 [detail/free_rollout_evidence.md](detail/free_rollout_evidence.md));② **rollout horizon 匹配动力学复杂度**(碰撞吃长 rollout、光滑域不吃);③ **几何 scale 增广作长程稳定器**(和长 horizon 协同,仿真上拿到 19×,且不反转)。**增广必须拆开看,不能整体算正面**:appearance 增广只是**简单合成域专属**的最强杠杆,一到照片级仿真就**反转 100×**(因为 appearance 在照片级场景里携带物理信息——摩擦/质量/材质,不是可抹掉的 nuisance)——所以 appearance 是**反面边界警示,不是正面方法**。正面框架 = 发现支配变量(free-rollout / horizon / scale),而非负结果堆;appearance 的反转本身也是一条贡献(合成→仿真的边界)。
32	
33	8. **发现三(方法论)**:四个评测陷阱——解释了为什么既有文献"看起来"物理结构有效(cos/probe 对偶陷阱)、为什么合成→仿真的边界被忽略。**顺手回收了别人被骗的原因。**
34	
35	9. **结论(建设性,不自我否定)**:我们没否定物理结构本身,只否定"往共享 latent 上**嫁接**"。**extrinsic 架构**(低维物理态是预测唯一必经通道)才让物理天然承重——PIWM 的红利来自它的**架构**,不是物理方程。这既解释了别人的正结果、又和我们的负结果自洽,还指出了唯一出路(future work)。
36	
37	---
38	
39	## 三个发现如何互锁(故事的精髓)
40	
41	不是三块拼盘,是**一个论证**:
42	
43	- 发现一说"结构没用" → 立刻有人问"是不是你实现有 bug / 指标不对"
44	- 发现二(训练协议大赢)证明**同一套代码、同一批指标下别的干预能大幅提升** → 排除"实现/指标失效",反衬出是结构本身没用
45	- 发现三(评测陷阱)解释**为什么别人以为结构有用** → 补上"那前人的正结果哪来的"这个缺口
46	- 机制(承重)+ LBR 验证把这三者**统一**到一个可证伪的解释下
47	
48	那个"1/30 的例外"不是漏洞,是**压舱石**:它精确符合机制预测(承重 + 匹配动力学才有用),证明我们的解释是对的、实现是对的——比"100% 全负"可信得多。
49	
50	### 最致命的质疑:"发现一结构没用是不是你实现有 bug"
51	
52	负结果最容易被这样打发——"你物理 loss 没真接进去,所以才看不出效果"。反驳的关键是**不辩"检查过代码"(苍白),而用模型的可观测行为证明约束真生效了**,只是生效方向无益/有害。区分:①bug 没接上 → 模型和 baseline 无异;②真生效 → 被约束改变、但方向有害。六条行为证据条条指向②:
53	
54	1. **structured_loss 2.53→0.015** → 接上了、在优化(没接上不会降);
55	2. **slot 位置可解码 0.31→0.96** → 约束把位置灌进了指定维度;
56	3. **恰在机制预测该赢的域(parabola)三种子确证生效** → 最硬一条:bug 若让物理整体失效,不可能挑域生效;
57	4. **按 pos_weight 甜点系统响应**(1/30/100→0.183/0.132/0.136)→ 不是随机行为;
58	5. **梯度比 15–125×、intrinsic dim 塌 39–90%** → 梯度在流、还在和预测拔河(直接测量);
59	6. **危害随注入强度单调**(from-scratch +0.558 vs 后训练 +0.035)→ 剂量-反应。
60	
61	外加 **free-rollout 阳性对照**(同代码同指标下大赢 2.2–3.6×)证明 pipeline/指标灵敏。**完整弹药与出处见 [detail/implementation_correctness.md](detail/implementation_correctness.md)。**
62	
63	---
64	
65	## 每节在故事里的角色
66	
67	| 节 | 角色 |
68	|---|---|
69	| Intro | 抛出"可解码≠遵守" + 缺口(析因没人做) |
70	| Related | 定位三条线(基准 / 物理结构 / exposure bias),点名将被检验的对象 |
71	| Setup | 交代受控实验设计(为什么 1K、为什么单机制、指标为什么用 nMSE/pixel) |
72	| §4 物理失效(心脏) | 发现一 + 承重机制 + LBR 可证伪验证 |
73	| §5 什么有效 | 发现二(训练/数据支配变量 + 合成→仿真边界) |
74	| §6 评测陷阱 | 发现三(回收"别人为什么被骗") |
75	| §7 结论 | 归因架构、指出 extrinsic 出路、诚实 limitation |
76	
77	---
78	
79	## 为什么这个故事能投 AAAI
80	
81	不靠"新方法"(free-rollout = Scheduled Sampling,增广有竞品,都不新),靠**一个反直觉、有机制、跨机制×域×数据集系统验证的科学发现**:
82	
83	> *物理归纳偏置在共享 latent 世界模型上系统性失效,因为信息可解码但不承重;真正的杠杆在训练协议。*
84	
85	加上评测方法论(cos 陷阱)和对 PIWM 的架构性归因,这是一篇诚实、完整、有解释力的实证论文——审稿人挑不出"证据不足"或"叙事不闭环"。详细创新性评估与审稿人反对意见预案见 [02_story_and_novelty.md](02_story_and_novelty.md);数字总账见 [01_results_ledger.md](01_results_ledger.md)。
